items.title: 輝達升逾2% 川普與中國談判可望推動進一步上漲
items.title_en: Nvidia Rises Over 2% as Trump‑China Talks Could Spur Further Gains
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，輝達(NVDA-US)正尋找能推動股價再次挑戰歷史新高的催化因素。本周美國總統川普與中國國家主席習近平的峰會，可能正是它需要的契機。
輝達股價周一(21日)收在227.38美元，漲幅2.3%。截至周一交易開始前，今年以來已上漲約19%，但目前仍低於5月14日創下的歷史收盤高點235.74美元。
對輝達而言，最理想情況就是川普與習近平能夠在AI發展方面達成協議，進而全面解除對輝達向中國銷售AI晶片的限制。
輝達執行長黃仁勳上周五接受CBS News訪問時表示，「美國已經做出決定，而我非常支持這項決定，我們應該優先讓美國企業取得輝達最好的技術。」
不過，黃仁勳也表示，他不同意全面禁止向中國企業銷售晶片，並認為美國供應商「應該在全球市場競爭」。
川普政府先前表示，將允許輝達向經過批准的中國客戶出貨H200 AI晶片。H200 的效能不如目前的Blackwell AI晶片，而且與即將推出的Vera Rubin系列相比，實際上已落後好幾代。輝達也同意，未來將把相關銷售收入的25%分給美國政府。
儘管H200有性能上的限制，中國企業仍可能願意購買約150萬顆H200處理器。據KeyBanc分析師John Vinh，這相當於約300億美元的營收。而輝達估計，中國市場對其晶片而言，整體潛在市場規模(TAM)約為500億美元。
不過，目前限制H200出貨的主要障礙其實來自中國政府。截至目前，中國只允許相對少量的H200晶片進口，原因之一是中方擔心，如果大量使用輝達晶片，可能會讓中國自身AI生態系過度依賴外國供應商。《金融時報》8月曾援引知情人士報導，中國政府已允許字節跳動與騰訊各自取得約1萬顆輝達H200處理器。
根據《華爾街日報》，黃仁勳預計將出席川普周四為習近平舉行的國宴。在AI議題上，黃仁勳通常與川普政府的方向一致，但如果輝達希望真正取得大規模對中國出貨的機會，可能需要這次峰會最終達成一項大型的美中AI合作協議。
另一方面，輝達高層仍持續從公司的巨大成功中獲益。根據監管文件，輝達財務長 Colette Kress在9月17日出售34,918股股票，價值約765萬美元。
這些交易是依10b5-1預先設定交易計畫執行。這類交易計畫會事先設定特定條件，例如股價達到某個價格或到達特定日期，一旦條件符合，就會觸發股票交易。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reports that Nvidia (NVDA‑US) is seeking a catalyst to push its stock back to a new all‑time high. This week’s summit between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping may be the opportunity it needs.

Nvidia’s share price closed at $227.38 on Monday (the 21st), up 2.3%. By the start of Monday’s trading it had risen about 19% year‑to‑date, but it still sits below the historic closing high of $235.74 set on May 14.
The ideal scenario for Nvidia would be for Trump and Xi to reach an agreement on AI development that would fully lift restrictions on Nvidia’s sales of AI chips to China.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told CBS News last Friday, “The United States has made a decision, and I fully support that decision. We should prioritize getting the best Nvidia technology into American companies.”
However, Huang also said he does not agree with a blanket ban on selling chips to Chinese firms and believes U.S. suppliers “should compete in the global market.”

The Trump administration previously said it would allow Nvidia to ship its H200 AI chips to approved Chinese customers. The H200 is less powerful than the current Blackwell AI chip and, compared with the upcoming Vera Rubin series, is actually several generations behind. Nvidia also agreed to remit 25% of the related sales revenue to the U.S. government.

Even with its performance limits, Chinese companies may still be willing to buy about 1.5 million H200 processors. KeyBanc analyst John Vinh estimates that equates to roughly $30 billion in revenue. Nvidia estimates the total addressable market (TAM) for its chips in China at about $50 billion.

The main obstacle to shipping H200 chips now actually comes from the Chinese government. So far China has allowed only a relatively small amount of H200 imports, partly because officials fear that large‑scale use of Nvidia chips could make China’s own AI ecosystem overly dependent on foreign suppliers. The Financial Times cited sources in August saying the Chinese government has permitted ByteDance and Tencent each to obtain about 10,000 Nvidia H200 processors.

According to the Wall Street Journal, Huang expects to attend the state dinner Trump will host for Xi on Thursday. On AI issues Huang usually aligns with the Trump administration’s stance, but if Nvidia wants a truly large‑scale shipping opportunity to China, it may need a major US‑China AI cooperation agreement to emerge from the summit.
Meanwhile, Nvidia executives continue to benefit from the company’s massive success. Regulatory filings show that CFO Colette Kress sold 34,918 shares on September 17, worth roughly $7.65 million.

These trades were executed under a pre‑established 10b5‑1 trading plan, which sets specific conditions—such as a target stock price or date—in advance, and triggers the transaction automatically once those conditions are met.

items.title: 〈貴金屬盤後〉Fed升息機率增、美元上揚 黃金下挫
items.title_en: Precious Metals After Hours: Higher Fed Rate‑Hike Odds, Stronger Dollar, Gold Falls
paras: 黃金周一(21日)走低，聯準會(Fed)今年再度升息機率升高，其他主要央行也釋出鷹派訊息，美元升值也打壓金價。

黃金現貨下跌0.6%，報每盎司4349.94美元，盤中一度跌逾1%至4322.19美元。
美國黃金期貨收低0.9%，報每盎司4383.90美元。


美元兌六種主要貨幣小幅走高，延續上周Fed升息後的漲勢。美元上周累計上漲逾1%，美元走強會讓以其他貨幣計價的投資人購買黃金的成本上升。
American Gold Exchange市場分析師Jim Wyckoff說：「我們看到金市多頭對美國貨幣政策收緊仍存在一些疑慮，這推動美元指數周五升至逾兩個月高點。這些利空因素正對貴金屬構成壓力。」
根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，交易員目前押注Fed 12月升息的機率達88%。
黃金傳統上被視為對抗通膨的避險工具，但在高利率環境下，相較於能產生收益的資產，黃金的吸引力會下降。
美以對伊朗戰爭推升能源價格，加劇市場對通膨的疑慮，也強化各國央行維持緊縮政策立場的理由，使金價較2月27日盤中高點下跌17%。
明尼亞波利斯聯準銀行總裁卡什卡里(Neel Kashkari)周日表示，美國通膨在各個經濟領域都過高，問題並不僅限於油價。
道明證券(TD Securities)分析師表示，他們預期「貴金屬市場近期任何走弱，都將僅限於大宗商品交易顧問(CTA)出現溫和賣壓」，而且市場將愈來愈把這種回落視為「買進黃金的機會」。

其他貴金屬交易


現貨白銀下跌0.4%，報每盎司65.99美元。
現貨白金上揚0.3%，報每盎司1805.83美元。
現貨鈀金攀升0.4%，報每盎司1307.33美元。
paras_en: Gold fell on Monday (the 21st) as the probability of another Fed rate hike this year rose and other major central banks also signaled hawkishness, while a stronger dollar put further pressure on gold prices.

Spot gold dropped 0.6% to $4,349.94 per ounce, briefly sinking more than 1% intraday to $4,322.19. U.S. gold futures fell 0.9% to $4,383.90 per ounce. The dollar edged higher against six major currencies, extending the rally that followed last week’s Fed hike. The dollar’s weekly gain of over 1% raises the cost for investors priced in other currencies to buy gold.

American Gold Exchange analyst Jim Wyckoff said, “We see that bullish sentiment in the gold market still harbors doubts about tightening U.S. monetary policy, which pushed the dollar index on Friday to a more than two‑month high. These downside factors are putting pressure on precious metals.”
According to CME’s FedWatch tool, traders are currently betting an 88% chance that the Fed will raise rates in December.
Gold is traditionally viewed as an inflation‑hedge, but in a high‑interest‑rate environment its appeal wanes compared with income‑generating assets.

The U.S.–Israel war on Iran has lifted energy prices, heightening inflation concerns and reinforcing central banks’ resolve to maintain tight policy, causing gold to fall 17% from its intraday high on February 27.
Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari said on Sunday that inflation is too high across all sectors of the U.S. economy, and the problem is not limited to oil prices.

TD Securities analysts said they expect any near‑term weakness in the precious‑metal market to be limited to modest selling by commodity‑trading advisors (CTAs), and that the market will increasingly view this pullback as a “buying opportunity” for gold.
Other precious metals: spot silver fell 0.4% to $65.99 per ounce; spot platinum rose 0.3% to $1,805.83 per ounce; spot palladium climbed 0.4% to $1,307.33 per ounce.

items.title: 看清美國無能為力！FT：波斯灣國家大夢初醒  齊呼「重置」對伊朗關係
items.title_en: Seeing the U.S.'s Powerlessness! FT: Gulf Nations Awaken from a Grand Dream, Call for a “Reset” of Relations with Iran
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，美以兩國聯手攻打伊朗數個月後，波斯灣國家正重新評估「靠華府保安全」的模式。
英國《金融時報》報導，卡達、阿聯在聯合國大會期間先後呼籲擴大與伊朗直接對話，沙烏地阿拉伯則與盟友研究包括互不侵犯安排在內的區域安全構想，顯示波灣國家試圖把伊朗納入一套可約束風險、而非僅靠美軍威懾的機制。
卡達首相兼外交大臣穆罕默德在紐約表示，美對伊戰事是對波斯灣的「警醒」，區域安全不能建立在任一國不安全的基礎上，應建立涵蓋海灣與伊朗的框架，避免相互威脅。
阿聯總統外交顧問加爾加什同樣主張，阿拉伯國家須與伊朗直接溝通。「美伊談判進展有限，穩定中東不能只由華府與德黑蘭決定。」
美伊開戰初期，阿聯曾遭大量導彈與無人機射向本土，阿布達比一度空襲伊朗，其後轉向降溫，以保金融、貿易與旅遊。
沙國壓力來自葉門胡塞武裝組織，近期持續遭後者飛彈、無人機攻擊，並威脅曼德與紅海航線。沙國曾希望美軍直接打胡塞，但川普政府迄今未全盤接受。
知情人士分析指出，沙國自開戰以來與盟友研議中東國家與伊朗訂互不侵犯安排，查塔姆研究所中東主任瓦基爾解讀，波斯灣國家領袖正面對「外部保護傘不再絕對可靠、對伊關係又持續緊張」的雙重局面，因此更想自己設計安全規則。
經濟是另一推力。荷姆茲海峽關係沙特、阿聯、卡達能源出口；戰事期間襲船與保險成本上升，迫使業者改道或重估運力。沙國原本以東西輸油管線把原油送至紅海延布港、減少依賴荷姆茲海峽，但管線部分設施遇襲關閉後，替代通道受限。
根據《彭博資訊》最新數據，沙國近期增加經波斯灣、荷姆茲出口，周末停靠波斯灣設施、具約1400萬桶裝載能力的油輪數增至6月以來高位。 這種「本想繞開、又被逼回海峽」的結構，使得波斯灣更有動機與伊朗談航運與降級。
9月聯合國大會則成新一輪接觸窗口。卡達持續在美伊之間斡旋，雙方雖未恢復直接談判，中間管道仍在；伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚、外長阿拉格齊預定赴紐約與會，伊朗總統預計周三(23日)在聯大發言。期間，美國總土川普將在紐約會晤波斯灣六國領袖，討論伊朗戰事下一步與戰後安排。
美國駐聯合國大使沃爾茲稱川普聯大講話將談到防止伊朗擁核。川普周日也向《福斯新聞》表示「可能」會佩澤希齊揚，但雙方尚無正式會談確認。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that months after the U.S. and Israel jointly attacked Iran, Gulf states are re‑evaluating the model of “relying on Washington for security.”

The Financial Times says Qatar and the United Arab Emirates, during the UN General Assembly, each urged expanded direct dialogue with Iran, while Saudi Arabia and its allies are studying regional‑security concepts that include non‑aggression pacts, showing Gulf states are trying to bring Iran into a risk‑mitigating framework rather than relying solely on U.S. military deterrence.

Qatar’s prime minister and foreign minister Mohammed said in New York that the U.S.–Iran war is a “wake‑up call” for the Gulf and that regional security cannot be built on any one country’s insecurity; a framework covering both the Gulf and Iran is needed to avoid mutual threats.

UAE presidential adviser Al‑Gharashi likewise argued that Arab states must communicate directly with Iran, noting “U.S.–Iran talks have made limited progress, and Middle‑East stability cannot be left to Washington and Tehran alone.”

In the early days of the U.S.–Iran conflict, the UAE was hit by a large volley of missiles and drones, prompting Abu Dhabi to launch an air strike on Iran before shifting to de‑escalation to protect its finance, trade and tourism sectors.

Saudi pressure comes from Yemen’s Houthi rebels, which have recently launched missiles and drones against Saudi targets and threatened the Bab al‑Mandab and Red Sea shipping lanes; Riyadh had hoped the U.S. would strike the Houthis directly, but the Trump administration has not fully embraced that option.

Informed sources say Saudi Arabia has been discussing a non‑aggression arrangement with Iran and other Middle‑East states since the war began. Waqir, director of the Middle‑East program at the Chatham Institute, interprets this as Gulf leaders facing a “dual dilemma” of an increasingly unreliable external security umbrella and persistently tense ties with Iran, prompting them to craft their own safety rules.

Economics is another driver. The Strait of Hormuz is vital for Saudi, UAE and Qatari energy exports; war‑time attacks on vessels and higher insurance costs have forced shippers to reroute or reassess capacity. Saudi Arabia had tried to shift crude to the Red Sea port of Yanbu via east‑west pipelines to reduce reliance on Hormuz, but parts of the pipeline were hit and shut, limiting alternative routes.

Bloomberg data show Saudi Arabia recently increased exports through the Gulf and Hormuz, with the number of tankers capable of loading about 14 million barrels at Gulf facilities rising to its highest level since June. This “intended‑to‑bypass‑but‑forced‑back‑into‑the‑strait” situation gives the Gulf more incentive to negotiate shipping and de‑escalation with Iran.

The September UN General Assembly provides a new window for contact. Qatar continues to mediate between the U.S. and Iran; although direct talks have not resumed, back‑channel links remain. Iran’s President Raisi and Foreign Minister Amir‑Abdollahian are slated to attend the New York session, with Raisi expected to speak on Wednesday the 23rd. Meanwhile, U.S. President Trump will meet the six Gulf leaders in New York to discuss the next steps in the Iran war and post‑war arrangements.

U.S. Ambassador to the UN Linda Thomas‑Greenfield said Trump’s UN speech will address preventing Iran from acquiring a nuclear weapon. Trump also told Fox News on Sunday that a “possible” meeting with President Raisi is on the table, though no formal talks have been confirmed.

items.title: 英特爾大漲12%安謀飆17% Meta AI代理Muse點燃晶片股漲勢
items.title_en: Intel Jumps 12% as Arm Soars 17% on Meta AI Agent Muse Fueling Chip Rally
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，英特爾(INTC-US)、AMD(AMD-US)與安謀(ARM-US)股價周一(21日)大幅上漲，投資人愈加看好CPU的潛在成長空間。這波行情的催化劑，似乎是 Meta Platforms(META-US)推出的 Muse人工智慧代理受到市場歡迎。
這波漲勢推動AMD收盤時的市值達到1兆美元，成為第14家達到這項里程碑的美國企業。
AMD股價周一上漲9.9%，收在615.52美元。根據道瓊市場數據，這也是AMD自6月30日以來首次創下歷史新高的收盤價。
英特爾股價與安謀的ADR股價漲幅更大，分別上漲12%與17%。
今年初，由於市場看好AI服務對CPU的需求，英特爾與安謀股價曾經歷一波強勁上漲，但進入夏季後半段，兩者股價又回落。
如今Muse AI代理的早期成功重新點燃了市場熱情。根據Sensor Tower，Muse過去三天一直是美國iPhone App Store下載量最高的免費應用程式。
AI代理的一項重要特性，就是可以自主執行任務。這類AI代理的普及可能大幅增加晶片在推論方面的需求，而這項工作不只需要GPU，也需要大量的CPU。英特爾執行長陳立武上周表示，公司目前只能滿足客戶大約50%的需求。
安謀預估，伺服器CPU市場每年可以成長超過35%，到2030年市場規模將達到1,200億美元。
AMD則更加樂觀。該公司預估，伺服器 CPU市場到2030年可能成長50%，創造約2,200億美元的營收機會。
AI代理今年已出現過一次引起市場關注的熱潮，其中包括開源AI助理專案 OpenClaw爆紅。不過，對沒有技術背景的使用者而言，OpenClaw的設定可能比較複雜，而且其主要開發者之後被OpenAI延攬。相比之下，Muse更容易讓一般使用者使用，且Meta擁有更多開發人員，可以投入資源持續改善Muse功能。
KeyBanc分析師Justin Patterson在報告中寫道，「我們認為，Meta的分發能力與數據優勢，讓Muse從第一天開始就具備優勢。如果Muse能在未來幾個月建立起數億人的每月活躍用戶群，而理想情況下甚至能形成數億人的每周活躍或日活躍用戶群，市場應該會視其為成功。」
當然，Muse仍面臨一些障礙。亞馬遜(AMZN-US)已經阻止Meta的Muse AI代理在其網站上進行購物。亞馬遜表示，Meta在讓Muse取得其平台存取權限之前，並沒有事先告知相關計畫。
亞馬遜發言人在聲明中表示，「我們認為，第三方應用程式如果提供代表消費者向其他企業進行購買的服務，就應該以公開的方式運作，並尊重服務提供商是否選擇參與的決定。像Muse這樣的代理型第三方應用程式，也必須遵守相同義務。我們已要求Meta將亞馬遜從這項體驗中移除。」
不過，這家電子商務巨頭甚至需要採取這樣的措施，本身就凸顯出Muse正在快速普及。而如果AI代理的市場真的持續蓬勃發展，CPU的需求也將同步增加——這對英特爾、安謀與AMD而言都是好消息。
Partners分析師Ivan Feinseth近期將英特爾 的目標價從118美元上調至145美元，同時維持買進評級。
Feinseth寫道，「AI正重新提升英特爾x86 CPU業務的重要性，因為推論、代理型AI、資料協調、網路及企業工作負載，都需要大量的一般用途運算能力，同時搭配加速運算。」
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that Intel (INTC-US), AMD (AMD-US) and Arm (ARM-US) saw their stocks surge on Monday the 21st, as investors grew more optimistic about the growth potential of CPUs. The catalyst appears to be Meta Platforms’ (META-US) Muse AI agent, which has been well received by the market.
The rally pushed AMD’s market value to $1 trillion at the close, making it the 14th U.S. company to reach that milestone.
AMD’s shares rose 9.9% on Monday, closing at $615.52. According to Dow Jones market data, this was also AMD’s first all‑time high closing price since June 30.
Intel’s stock and Arm’s ADR posted even larger gains, up 12% and 17% respectively.
Earlier this year, buoyed by expectations that AI services would drive CPU demand, Intel and Arm enjoyed a strong price run‑up, but their shares fell back in the second half of summer.
Now the early success of the Muse AI agent has reignited market enthusiasm. Sensor Tower says Muse has been the top‑downloaded free app in the U.S. iPhone App Store for the past three days.

A key feature of AI agents is autonomous task execution. Widespread adoption could sharply raise chip demand for inference, which requires not only GPUs but also large amounts of CPU power. Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger said last week the company can currently meet only about 50% of customer demand.
Arm estimates the server‑CPU market can grow more than 35% annually, reaching a $120 billion size by 2030.
AMD is even more bullish, projecting the server‑CPU market could grow 50% by 2030, creating roughly $220 billion of revenue opportunity.

AI agents have already sparked a market‑making wave this year, notably the open‑source assistant project OpenClaw. However, OpenClaw’s setup can be complex for non‑technical users and its lead developer was later recruited by OpenAI. By contrast, Muse is easier for the average user, and Meta has a larger developer pool to continuously improve Muse’s features.

KeyBanc analyst Justin Patterson wrote in a note, “We believe Meta’s distribution capability and data advantage give Muse a head‑start from day one. If Muse can build a monthly active user base of hundreds of millions in the coming months, and ideally hundreds of millions of weekly or daily active users, the market will view it as a success.”
Muse still faces hurdles. Amazon (AMZN-US) has blocked Meta’s Muse AI agent from shopping on its site, saying Meta did not inform Amazon in advance before seeking platform access for Muse.

An Amazon spokesperson said, “We believe third‑party apps that act on behalf of consumers to purchase from other businesses should operate transparently and respect the service provider’s choice to participate. Agent‑type third‑party apps like Muse must meet the same obligations. We have asked Meta to remove Amazon from this experience.”

Nevertheless, the fact that the e‑commerce giant feels the need to take such action underscores how quickly Muse is gaining traction. If the AI‑agent market continues to expand, CPU demand will rise in tandem – good news for Intel, Arm and AMD.
Partners analyst Ivan Feinseth recently raised Intel’s price target from $118 to $145 while maintaining a buy rating.

Feinseth wrote, “AI is re‑elevating the importance of Intel’s x86 CPU business because inference, agent‑type AI, data orchestration, networking and enterprise workloads all need massive general‑purpose compute, complemented by accelerators.”

items.title: 高油價+美債殖利率飆漲壓縮財政空間！IEA：全球94國出手補貼油價
items.title_en: High Oil Prices and US Treasury Yields Squeeze Fiscal Space! IEA: 94 Countries Subsidize Oil Prices
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，高油價衝擊正從加油站與家庭帳單，快速滲入各國主權財政。根據國際能源署(IEA)最新數據，全球實施直接燃料補貼的國家已由四個月前的16個增加至38個，調降能源稅國家由40個增至57個，推出某種消費者能源支援措施的國家達94個。隨著補貼網越鋪越大，政府承擔的價格緩衝成本也越重。
問題在於這輪干預恰逢全球融資環境緊縮；美國政府借款成本升至2007年以來高位，通膨與升息共同推高主權融資利率，能源補貼、債務利息開始擠占同一塊預算。
IMF等機構持續主張，能源支援應針對弱勢、短期化；普遍補貼若遇上油價長期居高不下，很容易由臨時救急變成長期財政負擔。
歐洲首當其衝。法國已延長原定9月底退場的高里程駕駛補助；德國總理默爾茨亦稱將盡快提出協助司機對抗高燃油成本方案；英國則面臨擴大低收入家庭能源支援的壓力。
英國能源監管機構Ofgem已確認下月典型家庭雙燃料帳單上調4%，年上限約1723英鎊。供應商EDF預估，若批發價格持續高位，明年1月還可能再漲26%，最終增幅取決於11月中前天然氣與電力批發價。
此外，歐洲入冬天然氣庫存又處低位，儲氣設施正常可滿足歐盟冬季約三分之一用氣，庫存不足使未來批發氣價與潛在補貼更受供需牽動。
一些分析人士認為，按當前補庫速度，要到75%低標都未必容易。法國總統馬克宏表示，G7未來數周將討論進一步釋出戰略石油與燃料儲備，若能壓低油價，可間接減輕補貼壓力。
但債市正在壓縮政策空間。歐盟已就主權債務殖利率「明顯上升」提出警告，要求成員國堅守中期財政目標，歐盟內部同時討論能源暴利稅，但委員會對全歐統一課稅態度審慎，成員國可自訂。
對政府而言，能源支援擴張等於同時支付兩筆帳：一邊補居民與企業，一邊以更高利率發債，財政降油價的能力日益受到公債成本約束。
亞洲則在補貼與削減補貼之間重新權衡。印尼承諾維持燃料補貼，馬來西亞以不同機制穩價，泰國自3月逐步退場；財政空間與油價耐受度不同，路徑便不同。
孟加拉周一(21日)把柴油由每升115塔卡調至135塔卡，汽油、煤油同步走漲，最高漲幅17.4%。孟國能源部指出，國際油價自3月以來漲逾一倍、運輸成本受地緣局勢推高，3至8月國有石油公司累虧2287.6億塔卡、約19億美元，新價可年減虧約1000億塔卡並省外匯。
拉美則呈兩極。巴西Petrobras上週加入新柴油補貼，每升1雷亞爾並可與既有每升1.12雷亞爾補助疊加。該公司披露柴油、汽油、液化石油氣相關補貼累計約99億雷亞爾，財政繼續硬扛。
玻利維亞在參議院通過19億美元IMF貸款後取消柴油補貼，改按國際價統一訂價；政府稱油氣補貼年支出約26億美元，多邊貸款不會再用於「高價進、低價出」，新方案要求削支出並在2027年前全面取消燃料補貼，但保留現金補助、優惠融資、部分進口稅減免與就業支持。
整體來看，高油價已把能源政策推向財政抉擇：補貼可短期壓帳單，卻會擴大赤字、推高發債成本；退出補貼可穩收支，卻把價格直接還給選民。冬季氣價、中東供應與債券收益率三者如何演變，將決定各國從「臨時緩衝」走向「長期負擔」還是「改革退場」。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that soaring oil prices are hitting gas stations and household bills, quickly spilling into sovereign finances worldwide. According to the International Energy Agency (IEA), the number of countries providing direct fuel subsidies has risen from 16 four months ago to 38, the number cutting energy taxes has grown from 40 to 57, and 94 countries now have some form of consumer energy support. As the subsidy net expands, governments bear heavier price‑buffer costs.

The problem is that this round of intervention coincides with a tightening global financing environment; U.S. government borrowing costs have risen to their highest level since 2007, and inflation together with rate hikes have pushed sovereign financing rates up, so energy subsidies and debt interest are crowding the same budget line.

Institutions such as the IMF continue to argue that energy support should target the vulnerable and be short‑term; broad subsidies that meet persistently high oil prices can easily shift from temporary relief to a long‑term fiscal burden.

Europe feels the impact first. France has extended its high‑mileage driver subsidy that was due to end at the end of September; German Chancellor Scholz said he will soon propose measures to help drivers cope with high fuel costs; the UK faces pressure to expand energy support for low‑income households.

The UK regulator Ofgem has confirmed a typical household dual‑fuel bill will rise 4% next month, with an annual cap of about £1,723. Supplier EDF estimates that if wholesale prices stay high, another 26% increase could come in January 2025, with the final rise depending on natural‑gas and electricity wholesale prices before mid‑November.

In addition, Europe’s winter gas inventories are low; storage facilities can normally meet about one‑third of EU winter gas demand, so insufficient stocks make future wholesale gas prices and potential subsidies more sensitive to supply‑demand dynamics.

Some analysts say that at the current replenishment rate, reaching the 75% low‑level target may not be easy. French President Macron said the G7 will discuss releasing strategic oil and fuel reserves in the coming weeks; if that can lower oil prices, it would indirectly ease subsidy pressure.

But bond markets are squeezing policy space. The EU has warned of a “significant rise” in sovereign‑debt yields, urging member states to stick to medium‑term fiscal targets. The EU is also debating an energy windfall tax, but the Commission is cautious about a Europe‑wide levy, leaving the tax design to individual countries.

For governments, expanding energy support means paying two bills at once: subsidising households and firms on one side, and issuing debt at higher rates on the other, so fiscal capacity to lower oil prices is increasingly constrained by bond‑cost pressures.

Asia is re‑balancing between subsidies and cuts. Indonesia has pledged to maintain fuel subsidies, Malaysia is stabilising prices through different mechanisms, and Thailand has been phasing out subsidies since March; differing fiscal space and oil‑price tolerance lead to different paths.

Bangladesh on Monday (the 21st) raised diesel from 115 to 135 taka per litre, with gasoline and kerosene also rising, the highest increase at 17.4%. The Energy Ministry said international oil prices have more than doubled since March and transport costs have risen due to geopolitical tensions; state oil firms lost 228.76 billion taka (about $19 billion) from March to August, and the new price could cut the loss by about 100 billion taka annually and save foreign‑exchange.

Latin America is split. Brazil’s Petrobras added a new diesel subsidy last week of 1 real per litre, which can be stacked with the existing 1.12‑real per litre subsidy. The company disclosed that subsidies for diesel, gasoline and LPG total about 9.9 billion reais, keeping the fiscal burden high.

Bolivia, after the Senate approved a $1.9 billion IMF loan, cancelled its diesel subsidy and moved to a uniform price based on international levels; the government said oil‑gas subsidies cost about $2.6 billion a year, and multilateral loans will no longer be used for “buy high, sell low”. The new plan calls for cutting spending and fully ending fuel subsidies by 2027, while retaining cash transfers, preferential financing, partial import‑tax relief and employment support.

Overall, high oil prices have pushed energy policy into a fiscal dilemma: subsidies can temporarily ease bills but expand deficits and raise borrowing costs; removing subsidies can stabilise finances but pass price pain directly to voters. How winter gas prices, Middle‑East supply and bond yields evolve will determine whether countries move from a “temporary buffer” to a “long‑term burden” or a “reform exit.”

items.title: 英美深化AI國防合作 柏南赴聯大宣布新夥伴關係
items.title_en: UK and US Deepen AI Defense Cooperation as Burnham Announces New Partnership at the UN General Assembly
paras: 英國首相安迪·柏南(Andy Burnham)將於周二(22日)在紐約舉行的聯合國大會期間宣布英國與美國新的人工智慧(AI)國防合作夥伴關係, 聚焦AI與自主技術, 目標是加快部署可信賴且具互通性的能力, 強化對關鍵基礎設施的保護及對安全威脅的威懾。
這也是柏南就任英國首相後首次參與多邊國際會議。他將在第81屆聯合國大會期間發表演說, 呼籲各國合作運用AI提升安全能力, 同時利用這項技術緩解生活成本壓力。柏南也將與美國總統川普會面。
根據英國政府規劃, 英國國防部的「國防快速AI交付工作小組」(Defence Rapid AI Delivery Taskforce)將與美國戰爭部(Department of War)首席數位與人工智慧辦公室(Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office)合作, 加快「可信賴、可互通能力」的交付, 以提升威懾能力。
柏南在聲明中表示, 英國與美國新的AI及自主技術國防夥伴關係, 將集合相關領域的人才與專業, 加強對關鍵基礎設施的保護, 威懾威脅英國安全的勢力, 並運用AI的潛力。
這項合作涵蓋的關鍵基礎設施範圍廣泛, 從海上航線至領空都包括在內。英國政府希望透過AI及自主技術, 提升對潛在威脅的偵測與應對能力, 同時讓英美雙方的相關技術與系統能夠更有效地協同運作。
英美目前在安全、科技、金融及更廣泛的外交政策領域維持密切合作, 儘管川普兩度執政期間, 雙方也曾出現公開分歧。柏南此次訪美因此具有深化雙邊合作的意義, 而AI國防合作將成為此次行程的重要議題之一。
英國目前是全球第三大AI市場, 僅次於美國與中國。Reuters指出, AI已出現協助英國擺脫長期經濟停滯的早期跡象, 但與此同時, 隨著AI系統能力快速提升, 外界對英國AI安全工作是否跟得上技術發展也日益關注。
英國設有AI安全研究院(AI Security Institute), 該機構是在英國於2023年主辦全球首屆AI安全高峰會後成立, 主要負責測試前沿AI模型, 評估其能力以及可能遭到濫用的風險。不過,根據報導， Anthropic近期未向該研究院提供最新模型, 引發外界對英國目前較偏向合作的AI治理模式是否足以因應日益增加的AI風險的疑慮。
柏南長期主張需要在AI帶來的機會與挑戰之間取得平衡。他預計在此次聯大行程中進一步宣布, 英國將在明年主辦20國集團(G20)期間推動國際社會處理AI等全球性挑戰。
明年的G20峰會預計於11月在英國曼徹斯特舉行。曼徹斯特位於英格蘭西北部, 也是柏南過去擔任地方政府領導人的地區。英國政府希望利用主辦G20的機會, 推動各國就AI所帶來的安全、經濟及社會議題展開更廣泛合作。
此次英美AI國防夥伴關係, 將AI、自主系統及關鍵基礎設施安全連結起來, 反映AI已逐漸成為英美國防與安全合作的重要領域。雙方後續如何落實相關技術合作, 以及如何在提升AI應用的同時處理安全與濫用風險, 將成為合作推進的重要議題。
paras_en: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham will announce a new artificial intelligence (AI) defence partnership with the United States during the United Nations General Assembly in New York on Tuesday (the 22nd), focusing on AI and autonomous technologies, with the goal of accelerating the deployment of trustworthy and interoperable capabilities, strengthening protection of critical infrastructure and deterring security threats.

This is Burnham’s first participation in a multilateral international conference since becoming UK Prime Minister. He will deliver a speech at the 81st UN General Assembly, calling on nations to cooperate in using AI to enhance security capabilities while also leveraging the technology to ease cost‑of‑living pressures. Burnham will also meet US President Trump.

According to the UK government plan, the Ministry of Defence’s Defence Rapid AI Delivery Taskforce will work with the US Department of War’s Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office to speed the delivery of “trustworthy, interoperable capabilities” in order to boost deterrence.

Burnham said the new AI and autonomous‑technology defence partnership between the UK and the US will bring together talent and expertise from the relevant fields, strengthen protection of critical infrastructure, deter forces that threaten UK security, and harness the potential of AI.

The cooperation covers a broad range of critical infrastructure, from maritime routes to airspace. The UK government hopes that AI and autonomous technologies will improve detection and response to potential threats, while enabling UK and US technologies and systems to operate more effectively together.

The UK and US currently maintain close cooperation in security, technology, finance and broader foreign‑policy areas, despite public disagreements during Trump’s two terms in office. Burnham’s visit therefore carries significance for deepening bilateral cooperation, and AI defence collaboration will be a major topic of the trip.

The UK is the world’s third‑largest AI market, behind the United States and China. Reuters notes early signs that AI is helping the UK break out of long‑term economic stagnation, but as AI system capabilities rapidly advance, external observers are increasingly concerned whether the UK’s AI safety work can keep pace with technological development.

The UK has an AI Security Institute, established after the country hosted the world’s first AI security summit in 2023, which is responsible for testing frontier AI models, assessing their capabilities and potential misuse risks. However, reports say Anthropic recently did not provide its latest model to the institute, raising doubts about whether the UK’s relatively collaborative AI‑governance approach is sufficient to address the growing AI risk landscape.

Burnham has long argued for balancing the opportunities and challenges presented by AI. He is expected to further announce during the UNGA that the UK will promote international efforts to tackle AI‑related global challenges during next year’s G20.

Next year’s G20 summit is slated for November in Manchester, England. Manchester, in the northwest of England, is also the region where Burnham previously served as a local government leader. The UK government hopes to use the G20 hosting opportunity to spur broader cooperation among nations on the security, economic and social issues raised by AI.

This UK‑US AI defence partnership links AI, autonomous systems and critical‑infrastructure security, reflecting AI’s growing role in defence and security cooperation between the two countries. How the partners will implement the technical collaboration and address safety and misuse risks while expanding AI applications will be key issues moving forward.

items.title: AI撐起美股近半獲利成長 高盛警告：明年這股動力恐減弱
items.title_en: AI Drives Nearly Half of US Stock Profit Growth, Goldman Warns Next Year's Momentum May Weaken
paras: 高盛(GS-US) 警告，人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮雖為今年美股企業獲利成長的主要推力之一，貢獻標普500指數成分股近半數的獲利增幅，但隨著企業資本支出增速回落，加上大規模基礎建設投資帶來的折舊費用，將開始侵蝕利潤，這項成長動力預料將自明年起逐步減弱。
儘管瑞銀最新報告預估，全球AI領域投資規模將由今年接近1兆美元，進一步攀升至明年的約1.4兆美元，高盛仍認為，即使企業持續向資料中心及晶片領域投入資金，AI投資熱潮對美股企業獲利成長的拉抬效果也將明顯降溫。
AI基建折舊開始侵蝕獲利
高盛首席美國股票策略師史奈德（Ben Snider）近日在研究報告中指出，根據高盛統計，2026年標普500指數企業的獲利成長中，近50%來自AI投資熱潮。
然而，隨著企業資本支出成長速度放緩，以及大規模AI基礎建設投資產生的折舊費用逐漸反映在財報上，這項有利因素將於明年開始消退。
史奈德表示，AI投資熱潮貢獻今年標普500企業近半數的獲利成長，但即使資本支出持續擴張，相關成長紅利明年仍將開始減弱。
在高盛的基準情境下，美股企業獲利成長不至於完全停滯，但增速將逐步放緩。
史奈德預估，2027年及2028年標普500成分股每股盈餘將分別成長11%，達到415美元及460美元。儘管仍維持兩位數成長，但相較今年第二季每股盈餘大增51%，以及過去四季平均成長26%，已顯著降溫。
晶片價格成美股獲利風險
高盛認為，在各產業當中，半導體業將是美股獲利成長的一大風險。自2022年底AI熱潮興起以來，半導體業一直是大型科技企業加碼AI投資的主要受益者之一。
在需求激增、供給受限的雙重支撐下，全球晶片製造商近年享有極高利潤率，但高盛認為，這種情況恐難長期延續。
史奈德指出，半導體業利潤率近期大幅上升，使標普500企業獲利更容易受到晶片價格下跌衝擊。高盛產業分析師預估，晶片供應至2027年底前仍將維持偏緊，但半導體業利潤率的擴張速度將於明年放緩。
高盛警告，若未來出現AI基礎建設投資降溫、晶片供給增加，或技術迭代壓低晶片價格等不利情境，標普500企業獲利可能受到明顯衝擊。依其估算，在上述情境下，標普500獲利恐縮水約10%。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs (GS-US) warned that the AI investment boom, while one of the main drivers of this year’s profit growth for US listed companies and contributing to almost half of the earnings increase among S&P 500 constituents, will start to erode profits as corporate capital‑expenditure growth slows and depreciation from large‑scale infrastructure investments rises, with this growth engine expected to gradually weaken from next year onward.

Even though UBS’s latest report estimates global AI investment to rise from close to $1 trillion this year to about $1.4 trillion next year, Goldman still believes that even as companies keep pouring money into data centers and chips, the profit‑boosting effect of the AI boom for US firms will noticeably cool.
AI infrastructure depreciation begins to erode profits

Goldman’s chief US equity strategist Ben Snider noted in a research note that, according to Goldman’s data, nearly 50% of the profit growth for S&P 500 companies in 2026 will stem from the AI investment boom.

However, as the pace of corporate cap‑ex slows and the depreciation from massive AI infrastructure spending starts to show up in financial statements, this favorable factor will begin to fade next year.

Snider said the AI boom contributed to almost half of this year’s profit growth for S&P 500 firms, but even if capital spending continues to expand, the related growth dividend will start to diminish next year.
In Goldman’s baseline scenario, US corporate profit growth will not come to a complete halt, but the pace will gradually decelerate.

Snider projects that earnings per share for S&P 500 constituents will grow 11% in both 2027 and 2028, reaching $415 and $460 respectively. Although double‑digit growth remains, it is a sharp slowdown from the 51% EPS surge in Q2 this year and the 26% average growth over the past four quarters.
Chip prices become profit risk for US stocks

Goldman sees the semiconductor sector as a major risk to US profit growth across industries. Since the AI surge at the end of 2022, semiconductors have been one of the main beneficiaries of big‑tech firms’ increased AI spending.
Supported by a surge in demand and constrained supply, global chip makers have enjoyed very high margins in recent years, but Goldman believes this situation is unlikely to persist long‑term.

Snider pointed out that the recent sharp rise in semiconductor margins makes S&P 500 earnings more vulnerable to a drop in chip prices. Goldman’s industry analysts estimate that chip supply will remain relatively tight through the end of 2027, but the pace of margin expansion in the semiconductor industry will slow next year.

Goldman warns that if AI infrastructure investment cools, chip supply expands, or technological cycles push chip prices lower, S&P 500 earnings could be hit noticeably. In such scenarios, Goldman estimates the index’s earnings could be trimmed by roughly 10%.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元升至近8周高點 歐元因德國政局受矚
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Rises to Near 8‑Week High; Euro in Focus Over German Politics
paras: 美元周一(19日)小幅走升，來到近8周高點，延續上周強勁漲勢，此前聯準會(Fed)進行了 3年多來首次升息。另一方面，日元在日本銀行(BoJ)決定收緊貨幣政策後，先前一波猛烈跌勢暫歇，歐元則因德國最新民調結果出爐而受矚。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報100.43，創7月29日以來最高。
本月市場最受關注議題之一，就是各大央行的升息行動。歐洲銀行(ECB)、聯準會與日本銀行近期都採取升息措施，且都提到了能源價格推動的通膨壓力。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上周在記者會上表示，「明確的事實就是通膨太高，而且已經持續太久。」
此前，聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率從3.50%-3.75%上調至 3.75%-4.00%。
此外，聯準會更新後的「經濟預測摘要」顯示，至少有12名FOMC委員認為今年還會再升息一次。
在FOMC做出升息決定之前，市場對聯準會升息的預期機率曾飆升至90%。推動市場預期的因素包括：油價急升、美國經濟數據，以及債券市場持續遭到拋售。尤其是固定收益市場投資人對這次升息反應正面，因他們認為這顯示聯準會沒有在通膨問題上落後於形勢。
Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management投資長Brent Schutte表示，「經濟的強勁表現，很可能就是聯準會認為可以升息的原因。但我們也提醒，升息的目的就是要放慢經濟成長速度。因此也會提高政策過度緊縮的風險，因為升息對經濟的影響延遲且不均。」
他進一步表示，「你們或許還記得，聯準會上一輪在2022年和2023年的升息，造成了經濟出現明顯分化。」當時，對利率較敏感的產業、企業及消費者面臨較大壓力，即使整體經濟仍持續成長。
歐元承受德國政治局勢轉變壓力
歐元兌美元下跌0.2%，至1歐元兌1.1463 美元。
歐洲交易市場正在消化周末公布的選舉預測結果。結果顯示，極右翼政黨「德國另類選擇黨」(AfD)在德國東北部的州選舉中取得領先。
這項具歷史意義的結果，直接打擊了德國總理梅爾茨(Friedrich Merz)領導的主流保守派聯盟，也讓歐洲股市面臨新的政治風險。
德銀的Jim Reid表示，「在極右派方面，AfD持續獲得更多支持，主要訴求包括反移民與反建制，尤其是在德國東部地區。」他也指出，左派政黨似乎則成功利用了民眾對住房負擔能力、生活成本以及社會不平等的擔憂。
他補充，「對市場而言，眼前最直接的影響並不是德國國家政策會立刻改變，而是德國政治中心進一步弱化，也再次提醒市場，推動歐洲政治兩極化的力量仍然存在。」
日元在升息、「利率檢查」後走弱
日元周一走弱，延續上周約2%猛烈跌勢。此前日銀公布利率決策後，日元跌至數周低點。
美元兌日元上漲0.3%，來到157.36日元。
日本金融市場周一因三天國定假期而休市。
由於假期期間流動性較低，全球交易員高度警戒日本政府可能進行外匯干預。過去在市場流動性不足的情況下，央行進場買進本國貨幣可能造成更大的價格波動。
讓市場對干預的擔憂進一步升高的是，《日本經濟新聞》上周五報導，日銀曾進行所謂的 「利率檢查」。這是指央行官員打電話給外匯交易部門，詢問市場上實際的買賣價。
日本銀行上周五將借貸成本提高至1.25%，創下31年來最高水準。
然而，兩名委員投下偏寬鬆政策的反對票，加上日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)強調政策需要進行預先性的調整，最初反而引發市場「利多出盡」反應。
這也迫使日本當局開始採取更積極的口頭警告及「利率檢查」，以支撐日元匯率。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Monday (the 19th), reaching a near‑8‑week high and continuing last week’s strong rally after the Federal Reserve delivered its first rate hike in more than three years. Meanwhile, the yen’s sharp slide eased after the Bank of Japan tightened policy, and the euro drew attention following the release of Germany’s latest poll results.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 100.43, its highest level since July 29.

One of the market’s top topics this month is the rate‑hike actions of major central banks. The European Central Bank, the Federal Reserve and the Bank of Japan have all recently raised rates and all cited inflation pressure from energy prices.
Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said at a press conference last week that “the clear fact is that inflation is too high and has been too persistent.”
Earlier, the Federal Open Market Committee voted unanimously to lift the federal funds rate range from 3.50‑3.75% to 3.75‑4.00%.
In addition, the Fed’s updated Summary of Economic Projections showed that at least 12 FOMC members expect another rate hike this year.

Before the FOMC’s decision, market expectations for a Fed hike had surged to 90%. Drivers of that expectation included a sharp rise in oil prices, U.S. economic data and continued bond‑market selling. Fixed‑income investors reacted positively, seeing the hike as evidence that the Fed is not lagging behind inflation pressures.

Brent Schutte, Chief Investment Officer at Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management, said, “The economy’s strong performance is likely why the Fed feels it can raise rates. But we remind that the purpose of tightening is to slow growth, which raises the risk of overtightening because the impact of rate hikes is delayed and uneven.”

He added, “You may recall the Fed’s previous tightening cycles in 2022‑2023 caused a clear split in the economy.” At that time, rate‑sensitive industries, firms and consumers felt heightened pressure even as overall growth continued.
Euro Under Pressure From Shifts in German Politics
The euro fell 0.2% against the dollar to $1.1463 per euro.
European markets are digesting the election‑forecast results released over the weekend, which showed the far‑right Alternative for Germany (AfD) leading in state elections in Germany’s northeast.
The historic outcome directly hit the mainstream conservative Union bloc led by Chancellor Friedrich Merz and added new political risk to European equities.

Jim Reid of Deutsche Bank said, “On the far‑right, the AfD is gaining more support, driven mainly by anti‑immigration and anti‑establishment messages, especially in eastern Germany.” He also noted that left‑wing parties seem to be capitalising on public concerns about housing affordability, living costs and social inequality.

He added, “For markets, the most immediate impact isn’t an immediate change in German national policy, but a further weakening of Germany’s political centre, reminding investors that forces driving European political polarisation remain present.”
Yen Weakens After Rate Hike and “Rate Check”
The yen weakened on Monday, extending last week’s roughly 2% plunge. Earlier, the yen fell to a multi‑week low after the BOJ announced its rate decision.
The dollar rose 0.3% against the yen to 157.36 yen.
Japan’s financial markets were closed on Monday for a three‑day national holiday.

Because liquidity is thin during the holiday, global traders are on high alert for possible foreign‑exchange intervention by the Japanese government. In past low‑liquidity episodes, central‑bank purchases of the domestic currency have amplified price swings.

Market worries about intervention were heightened after Nikkei reported last Friday that the BOJ had carried out a so‑called “rate check,” meaning officials called FX desks to ask about actual bid‑ask prices in the market.
The Bank of Japan raised its borrowing cost to 1.25% last Friday, the highest level in 31 years.

However, two board members cast votes for a more accommodative stance, and Governor Kazuo Ueda stressed that policy needed a pre‑emptive adjustment, initially prompting a “no‑more‑good‑news” reaction in the market.
That forced Japanese authorities to adopt more aggressive verbal warnings and conduct “rate checks” to support the yen’s exchange rate.

Taiwan’s market rose over 1,000 points last week, and high‑yield ETFs led the rally, with Yuanta High Dividend (0056‑TW) reaching a new size peak, breaking the NT$8 trillion mark and setting a fresh benchmark for high‑dividend funds. Both the current‑economy optimism index and the outlook index rebounded, and willingness for large‑ticket consumption rose. Boosted by strong AI fundamentals, Taiwanese market sentiment and risk appetite recovered sharply. Over half of respondents expect annual GDP growth to exceed 11%, showing strong confidence in the economy, while more than half still see inflation above 2.5% for the year and nearly 80% anticipate inflation remaining above 2% a year from now.

Microsoft (MSFT‑US) Taiwan General Manager Bian Zhixiang said on Monday (the 21st) that global demand for compute power still outstrips supply and will continue for the next two to three years. items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Shocks with Lianmao's NT$319 Million Default Settlement, Setting Year's Highest Single-Deal Record
paras: 台股今(21)日多頭氣勢如虹，大盤上漲 538 點、以歷史次高點 47,718 點亮麗收盤。不過，證交所晚間公告，北城證券申報銅箔基板(CCL)大廠聯茂(6213-TW)鉅額違約交割，金額高達 3.19 億元。這不僅是今年 8、9 月以來首宗上市公司違約案件，更一舉刷新今年上市櫃單次違約交割的最高金額紀錄。
根據證交所統計，今年以來集中市場的鉅額違約交割累計已達 12 起，相關個股包括旺宏(2337-TW)、佳必琪(6197-TW)、新日興(3376-TW)、欣興(3037-TW)、華通(2313-TW)、友達(2409-TW)、禾伸堂(3026-TW)、南亞科(2408-TW)、聯茂，以及被通報多達 3 次的被動元件龍頭國巨*(2327-TW)。
若再加上櫃買市場的 13 起案例，今年上市櫃合計已發生多達 25 起鉅額違約交割事件，反映出近期高檔震盪劇烈，部分槓桿操作過度的投資人面臨資金卡關危機。
根據 T+2 制度回推，聯茂違約交割實際交易日落在 9/17，當天股價開高走低直接殺至跌停，部分當沖或使用高槓桿(如資券操作、開放大額信用額度)的投資人，可能原本預期當天開高可順利當沖獲利落袋，不料股價一路下殺跌停導致當沖無法平倉或當沖補價差金額過大，且無法於 T+2 日補足高達 3.19 億元的款項，最終演變成鉅額違約交割事件。
為遏止違約交割亂象，證交所日前董事會已通過修正規定，實施加嚴處置措施，未來首次違約結案者的追蹤列管期由一年大幅拉長至五年，且恢復交易後連續 10 個營業日須執行「全額預收款券」；若為兩次以上違約的累犯者，同樣列管五年，但預收款券期間則加重提高至連續 30 個營業日，希望透過拉長列管年限與提高預收天數，防範投機客換券商下單的套利風險與信用危機。
paras_en: The Taiwan market surged today (21st) with the index climbing 538 points to close brightly at a historic near‑high of 47,718 points. However, the exchange announced in the evening that North City Securities reported a massive default settlement by copper foil substrate (CCL) giant Lianmao (6213‑TW) amounting to NT$319 million. This is not only the first listed‑company default case since August‑September of this year, but also sets a new record for the highest single default settlement amount among listed companies in 2024.

According to exchange statistics, there have been 12 large‑scale default settlements in the main market so far this year, involving stocks such as Wondong (2337‑TW), Jabiqi (6197‑TW), Xinri Xing (3376‑TW), Xin Xing (3037‑TW), Huadong (2313‑TW), AU Optronics (2409‑TW), Hoshintang (3026‑TW), Nanya Technology (2408‑TW), Lianmao, and the passive component leader Yageo* (2327‑TW), which has been reported three times.

Including 13 cases from the OTC market, a total of 25 large‑scale default settlements have occurred among listed and OTC securities this year, reflecting recent volatile high‑price swings and indicating that some heavily leveraged investors are facing cash‑flow crunches.

Based on the T+2 settlement system, Lianmao's default settlement traces back to the actual trade date of September 17. The stock opened higher that day but fell sharply to the limit‑down price, trapping day‑traders and highly leveraged participants (such as those using securities‑based margin or large credit lines). Those who expected to profit from an opening rally found their positions unable to be closed or required excessive price‑difference payments, and could not cover the NT$319 million by the T+2 deadline, resulting in a massive default settlement.

To curb such default incidents, the exchange’s board recently approved amended rules tightening penalties. The monitoring period for first‑time violators will be extended from one year to five years, and after resuming trading they must hold “full‑amount pre‑collected vouchers” for 10 consecutive business days. Repeat offenders (two or more defaults) will also be monitored for five years, but the pre‑collected voucher period will increase to 30 consecutive business days, aiming to deter speculative arbitrage and credit risks from switching brokers.

items.title: 鋼鐵輸歐配額「黑箱」？ 經濟部：8成業者沿用舊制 自由配額維持20%
items.title_en: Steel Exports to EU Quota “Black Box”? Ministry of Economic Affairs: 80% of Firms Use Old System, Free Quota Remains at 20%
paras: 經濟部今（21）日針對媒體報導「貿易署輸歐關稅配額黑箱作業？疑圖利特定貿易商」澄清指出，輸歐盟鋼鐵產品出口管理措施係因應歐盟鋼鐵防衛措施，相關配額管理分配方式已實施多年，並非新創作法，均依產業實際狀況，並徵詢業者意見後決定，絕無黑箱作業。
歐盟自2019年起實施鋼鐵防衛措施，採取關稅配額方式。經濟部自2019年至2025年間，為協助廠商因應此措施及維護貿易秩序，每年均公告對輸歐盟鋼鐵產品採行出口管理措施。歐盟鋼鐵防衛措施於本年6月30日屆期，並自本年7月1日起同樣採取關稅配額方式，管制輸入歐盟之鋼鐵產品。本次管理措施實施前，經濟部亦循例透過鋼鐵公會協助調查業者意見，有近8成業者同意比照過往防衛措施期間之機制，進行出口配額管理。
經濟部說明，輸歐鋼鐵產品出口管理措施係將獲配之各類別鋼鐵產品國家配額分為「出口實績配額」及「自由申請配額」。「出口實績配額」係考量歐盟計算國家配額之方式，按各廠商2022年至2024年之平均出口量比例進行分配。「自由申請配額」則必須檢附3個月內交貨之交易證明文件，且在獲配配額已用完或可用額度不足以履行單一交易時，才能提出申請，由鋼鐵公會於每個工作日按當日申請量及剩餘量依比例核配。
針對外界質疑「自由申請配額」已協商結論為20%，被擅自提高至20%一節，經濟部強調並非事實。自2019年以來，經濟部每年透過鋼鐵公會徵詢各類別鋼鐵產品業者對出口實績配額與自由申請配額占比之意見，綜合考量各類別業者需求及產業實際狀況，如業者對占比無共識，依過往慣例將自由申請配額訂為20%，此作法已行之有年，並無先與業者承諾20%比例後，提高為20%之情形。
經濟部進一步指出，考量國內製造商亦有與貿易商合作出口鋼鐵產品之需求，為兼顧國際貿易實務，有出口實績之貿易商可申請「自由申請配額」，在「自由申請配額」的規範上，對貿易商的申請條件較為嚴格。貿易商必須具有過往出口實績，且在獲配配額用完或可用額度不足以履行單一交易時，始可申請自由配額。相對而言，未獲「出口實績配額」之鋼鐵製造業廠商，則無需出口實績即可申請自由配額。
有關歐盟鋼品配額之分配與管理，經濟部將依循既有機制，參酌產業實際狀況及業者意見辦理；各項額度申請須檢具實際訂單證明，並依相關原則核配。經濟部將持續與業者溝通，滾動檢討相關管理措施。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs clarified today (the 21st) that media reports alleging a “black‑box” operation by the Trade Office in allocating EU steel tariff quotas to benefit certain traders are unfounded. The export management measures for steel products to the EU are a response to the EU’s steel safeguard measures, and the quota allocation method has been in place for many years, not a newly created rule. It is based on the actual industry situation and was decided after consulting firms, with no black‑box procedures involved.

Since 2019 the EU has implemented steel safeguard measures using a tariff‑quota system. From 2019 to 2025 the Ministry of Economic Affairs has each year announced export management measures for steel products destined for the EU to help companies cope with the measures and maintain trade order. The EU’s safeguard measures expired on June 30 this year and, starting July 1, the EU again adopted a tariff‑quota system to control steel imports. Before implementing the current measures, the ministry, as usual, sought industry opinions through the Steel Association, and nearly 80% of firms agreed to manage export quotas in the same way as during the previous safeguard period.

The ministry explained that the export management measures for steel products to the EU divide the national quota for each steel category into an “export‑performance quota” and a “free‑application quota.” The export‑performance quota is allocated according to each company’s average export share from 2022 to 2024, reflecting how the EU calculates national quotas. The free‑application quota can be claimed only when a company provides transaction documents showing delivery within the past three months and when its allocated quota is exhausted or insufficient for a single transaction; the Steel Association then allocates the remaining amount each working day on a proportional basis.

Regarding external doubts that the “free‑application quota” was negotiated at 20% and then arbitrarily raised to 20%, the ministry stressed this is not true. Since 2019 the ministry has each year consulted firms of each steel category on the split between export‑performance and free‑application quotas. After weighing the needs of each category and the actual industry situation, if firms cannot reach a consensus on the split, the ministry follows past practice and sets the free‑application quota at 20%. This practice has been in place for years and there was never a prior promise of 20% that was later increased.

The ministry further noted that, considering domestic manufacturers also need to cooperate with traders to export steel, the free‑application quota is available to traders with export records, but the application criteria are stricter. Traders must have prior export performance and may apply for the free quota only when their allocated quota is used up or insufficient for a single deal. By contrast, steel manufacturers that did not receive an export‑performance quota can apply for the free quota without having export history.

Regarding the allocation and management of EU steel quotas, the ministry will continue to follow the existing mechanism, taking into account actual industry conditions and firms’ opinions. All quota applications must be supported by actual order documentation and will be allocated according to the relevant principles. The ministry will keep communicating with firms and will continuously review the management measures.

items.title: 輝達升逾2% 川普與中國談判可望推動進一步上漲
items.title_en: Nvidia Rises Over 2% as Trump‑China Talks Could Spur Further Gains
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，輝達(NVDA-US)正尋找能推動股價再次挑戰歷史新高的催化因素。本周美國總統川普與中國國家主席習近平的峰會，可能正是它需要的契機。
輝達股價周一(21日)收在227.38美元，漲幅2.3%。截至周一交易開始前，今年以來已上漲約19%，但目前仍低於5月14日創下的歷史收盤高點235.74美元。
對輝達而言，最理想情況就是川普與習近平能夠在AI發展方面達成協議，進而全面解除對輝達向中國銷售AI晶片的限制。
輝達執行長黃仁勳上周五接受CBS News訪問時表示，「美國已經做出決定，而我非常支持這項決定，我們應該優先讓美國企業取得輝達最好的技術。」
不過，黃仁勳也表示，他不同意全面禁止向中國企業銷售晶片，並認為美國供應商「應該在全球市場競爭」。
川普政府先前表示，將允許輝達向經過批准的中國客戶出貨H200 AI晶片。H200 的效能不如目前的Blackwell AI晶片，而且與即將推出的Vera Rubin系列相比，實際上已落後好幾代。輝達也同意，未來將把相關銷售收入的25%分給美國政府。
儘管H200有性能上的限制，中國企業仍可能願意購買約150萬顆H200處理器。據KeyBanc分析師John Vinh，這相當於約300億美元的營收。而輝達估計，中國市場對其晶片而言，整體潛在市場規模(TAM)約為500億美元。
不過，目前限制H200出貨的主要障礙其實來自中國政府。截至目前，中國只允許相對少量的H200晶片進口，原因之一是中方擔心，如果大量使用輝達晶片，可能會讓中國自身AI生態系過度依賴外國供應商。《金融時報》8月曾援引知情人士報導，中國政府已允許字節跳動與騰訊各自取得約1萬顆輝達H200處理器。
根據《華爾街日報》，黃仁勳預計將出席川普周四為習近平舉行的國宴。在AI議題上，黃仁勳通常與川普政府的方向一致，但如果輝達希望真正取得大規模對中國出貨的機會，可能需要這次峰會最終達成一項大型的美中AI合作協議。
另一方面，輝達高層仍持續從公司的巨大成功中獲益。根據監管文件，輝達財務長 Colette Kress在9月17日出售34,918股股票，價值約765萬美元。
這些交易是依10b5-1預先設定交易計畫執行。這類交易計畫會事先設定特定條件，例如股價達到某個價格或到達特定日期，一旦條件符合，就會觸發股票交易。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reports that Nvidia (NVDA‑US) is seeking a catalyst to push its stock back to a new all‑time high. This week’s summit between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping may be the opportunity it needs.

Nvidia’s share price closed at $227.38 on Monday (the 21st), up 2.3%. By the start of Monday’s trading it had risen about 19% year‑to‑date, but it still sits below the historic closing high of $235.74 set on May 14.
The ideal scenario for Nvidia would be for Trump and Xi to reach an agreement on AI development that would fully lift restrictions on Nvidia’s sales of AI chips to China.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told CBS News last Friday, “The United States has made a decision, and I fully support that decision. We should prioritize getting the best Nvidia technology into American companies.”
However, Huang also said he does not agree with a blanket ban on selling chips to Chinese firms and believes U.S. suppliers “should compete in the global market.”

The Trump administration previously said it would allow Nvidia to ship its H200 AI chips to approved Chinese customers. The H200 is less powerful than the current Blackwell AI chip and, compared with the upcoming Vera Rubin series, is actually several generations behind. Nvidia also agreed to remit 25% of the related sales revenue to the U.S. government.

Even with its performance limits, Chinese companies may still be willing to buy about 1.5 million H200 processors. KeyBanc analyst John Vinh estimates that equates to roughly $30 billion in revenue. Nvidia estimates the total addressable market (TAM) for its chips in China at about $50 billion.

The main obstacle to shipping H200 chips now actually comes from the Chinese government. So far China has allowed only a relatively small amount of H200 imports, partly because officials fear that large‑scale use of Nvidia chips could make China’s own AI ecosystem overly dependent on foreign suppliers. The Financial Times cited sources in August saying the Chinese government has permitted ByteDance and Tencent each to obtain about 10,000 Nvidia H200 processors.

According to the Wall Street Journal, Huang expects to attend the state dinner Trump will host for Xi on Thursday. On AI issues Huang usually aligns with the Trump administration’s stance, but if Nvidia wants a truly large‑scale shipping opportunity to China, it may need a major US‑China AI cooperation agreement to emerge from the summit.
Meanwhile, Nvidia executives continue to benefit from the company’s massive success. Regulatory filings show that CFO Colette Kress sold 34,918 shares on September 17, worth roughly $7.65 million.

These trades were executed under a pre‑established 10b5‑1 trading plan, which sets specific conditions—such as a target stock price or date—in advance, and triggers the transaction automatically once those conditions are met.

items.title: 英特爾大漲12%安謀飆17% Meta AI代理Muse點燃晶片股漲勢
items.title_en: Intel Jumps 12% as Arm Soars 17% on Meta AI Agent Muse Fueling Chip Rally
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，英特爾(INTC-US)、AMD(AMD-US)與安謀(ARM-US)股價周一(21日)大幅上漲，投資人愈加看好CPU的潛在成長空間。這波行情的催化劑，似乎是 Meta Platforms(META-US)推出的 Muse人工智慧代理受到市場歡迎。
這波漲勢推動AMD收盤時的市值達到1兆美元，成為第14家達到這項里程碑的美國企業。
AMD股價周一上漲9.9%，收在615.52美元。根據道瓊市場數據，這也是AMD自6月30日以來首次創下歷史新高的收盤價。
英特爾股價與安謀的ADR股價漲幅更大，分別上漲12%與17%。
今年初，由於市場看好AI服務對CPU的需求，英特爾與安謀股價曾經歷一波強勁上漲，但進入夏季後半段，兩者股價又回落。
如今Muse AI代理的早期成功重新點燃了市場熱情。根據Sensor Tower，Muse過去三天一直是美國iPhone App Store下載量最高的免費應用程式。
AI代理的一項重要特性，就是可以自主執行任務。這類AI代理的普及可能大幅增加晶片在推論方面的需求，而這項工作不只需要GPU，也需要大量的CPU。英特爾執行長陳立武上周表示，公司目前只能滿足客戶大約50%的需求。
安謀預估，伺服器CPU市場每年可以成長超過35%，到2030年市場規模將達到1,200億美元。
AMD則更加樂觀。該公司預估，伺服器 CPU市場到2030年可能成長50%，創造約2,200億美元的營收機會。
AI代理今年已出現過一次引起市場關注的熱潮，其中包括開源AI助理專案 OpenClaw爆紅。不過，對沒有技術背景的使用者而言，OpenClaw的設定可能比較複雜，而且其主要開發者之後被OpenAI延攬。相比之下，Muse更容易讓一般使用者使用，且Meta擁有更多開發人員，可以投入資源持續改善Muse功能。
KeyBanc分析師Justin Patterson在報告中寫道，「我們認為，Meta的分發能力與數據優勢，讓Muse從第一天開始就具備優勢。如果Muse能在未來幾個月建立起數億人的每月活躍用戶群，而理想情況下甚至能形成數億人的每周活躍或日活躍用戶群，市場應該會視其為成功。」
當然，Muse仍面臨一些障礙。亞馬遜(AMZN-US)已經阻止Meta的Muse AI代理在其網站上進行購物。亞馬遜表示，Meta在讓Muse取得其平台存取權限之前，並沒有事先告知相關計畫。
亞馬遜發言人在聲明中表示，「我們認為，第三方應用程式如果提供代表消費者向其他企業進行購買的服務，就應該以公開的方式運作，並尊重服務提供商是否選擇參與的決定。像Muse這樣的代理型第三方應用程式，也必須遵守相同義務。我們已要求Meta將亞馬遜從這項體驗中移除。」
不過，這家電子商務巨頭甚至需要採取這樣的措施，本身就凸顯出Muse正在快速普及。而如果AI代理的市場真的持續蓬勃發展，CPU的需求也將同步增加——這對英特爾、安謀與AMD而言都是好消息。
Partners分析師Ivan Feinseth近期將英特爾 的目標價從118美元上調至145美元，同時維持買進評級。
Feinseth寫道，「AI正重新提升英特爾x86 CPU業務的重要性，因為推論、代理型AI、資料協調、網路及企業工作負載，都需要大量的一般用途運算能力，同時搭配加速運算。」
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that Intel (INTC-US), AMD (AMD-US) and Arm (ARM-US) saw their stocks surge on Monday the 21st, as investors grew more optimistic about the growth potential of CPUs. The catalyst appears to be Meta Platforms’ (META-US) Muse AI agent, which has been well received by the market.
The rally pushed AMD’s market value to $1 trillion at the close, making it the 14th U.S. company to reach that milestone.
AMD’s shares rose 9.9% on Monday, closing at $615.52. According to Dow Jones market data, this was also AMD’s first all‑time high closing price since June 30.
Intel’s stock and Arm’s ADR posted even larger gains, up 12% and 17% respectively.
Earlier this year, buoyed by expectations that AI services would drive CPU demand, Intel and Arm enjoyed a strong price run‑up, but their shares fell back in the second half of summer.
Now the early success of the Muse AI agent has reignited market enthusiasm. Sensor Tower says Muse has been the top‑downloaded free app in the U.S. iPhone App Store for the past three days.

A key feature of AI agents is autonomous task execution. Widespread adoption could sharply raise chip demand for inference, which requires not only GPUs but also large amounts of CPU power. Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger said last week the company can currently meet only about 50% of customer demand.
Arm estimates the server‑CPU market can grow more than 35% annually, reaching a $120 billion size by 2030.
AMD is even more bullish, projecting the server‑CPU market could grow 50% by 2030, creating roughly $220 billion of revenue opportunity.

AI agents have already sparked a market‑making wave this year, notably the open‑source assistant project OpenClaw. However, OpenClaw’s setup can be complex for non‑technical users and its lead developer was later recruited by OpenAI. By contrast, Muse is easier for the average user, and Meta has a larger developer pool to continuously improve Muse’s features.

KeyBanc analyst Justin Patterson wrote in a note, “We believe Meta’s distribution capability and data advantage give Muse a head‑start from day one. If Muse can build a monthly active user base of hundreds of millions in the coming months, and ideally hundreds of millions of weekly or daily active users, the market will view it as a success.”
Muse still faces hurdles. Amazon (AMZN-US) has blocked Meta’s Muse AI agent from shopping on its site, saying Meta did not inform Amazon in advance before seeking platform access for Muse.

An Amazon spokesperson said, “We believe third‑party apps that act on behalf of consumers to purchase from other businesses should operate transparently and respect the service provider’s choice to participate. Agent‑type third‑party apps like Muse must meet the same obligations. We have asked Meta to remove Amazon from this experience.”

Nevertheless, the fact that the e‑commerce giant feels the need to take such action underscores how quickly Muse is gaining traction. If the AI‑agent market continues to expand, CPU demand will rise in tandem – good news for Intel, Arm and AMD.
Partners analyst Ivan Feinseth recently raised Intel’s price target from $118 to $145 while maintaining a buy rating.

Feinseth wrote, “AI is re‑elevating the importance of Intel’s x86 CPU business because inference, agent‑type AI, data orchestration, networking and enterprise workloads all need massive general‑purpose compute, complemented by accelerators.”

items.title: AI撐起美股近半獲利成長 高盛警告：明年這股動力恐減弱
items.title_en: AI Drives Nearly Half of US Stock Profit Growth, Goldman Warns Next Year's Momentum May Weaken
paras: 高盛(GS-US) 警告，人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮雖為今年美股企業獲利成長的主要推力之一，貢獻標普500指數成分股近半數的獲利增幅，但隨著企業資本支出增速回落，加上大規模基礎建設投資帶來的折舊費用，將開始侵蝕利潤，這項成長動力預料將自明年起逐步減弱。
儘管瑞銀最新報告預估，全球AI領域投資規模將由今年接近1兆美元，進一步攀升至明年的約1.4兆美元，高盛仍認為，即使企業持續向資料中心及晶片領域投入資金，AI投資熱潮對美股企業獲利成長的拉抬效果也將明顯降溫。
AI基建折舊開始侵蝕獲利
高盛首席美國股票策略師史奈德（Ben Snider）近日在研究報告中指出，根據高盛統計，2026年標普500指數企業的獲利成長中，近50%來自AI投資熱潮。
然而，隨著企業資本支出成長速度放緩，以及大規模AI基礎建設投資產生的折舊費用逐漸反映在財報上，這項有利因素將於明年開始消退。
史奈德表示，AI投資熱潮貢獻今年標普500企業近半數的獲利成長，但即使資本支出持續擴張，相關成長紅利明年仍將開始減弱。
在高盛的基準情境下，美股企業獲利成長不至於完全停滯，但增速將逐步放緩。
史奈德預估，2027年及2028年標普500成分股每股盈餘將分別成長11%，達到415美元及460美元。儘管仍維持兩位數成長，但相較今年第二季每股盈餘大增51%，以及過去四季平均成長26%，已顯著降溫。
晶片價格成美股獲利風險
高盛認為，在各產業當中，半導體業將是美股獲利成長的一大風險。自2022年底AI熱潮興起以來，半導體業一直是大型科技企業加碼AI投資的主要受益者之一。
在需求激增、供給受限的雙重支撐下，全球晶片製造商近年享有極高利潤率，但高盛認為，這種情況恐難長期延續。
史奈德指出，半導體業利潤率近期大幅上升，使標普500企業獲利更容易受到晶片價格下跌衝擊。高盛產業分析師預估，晶片供應至2027年底前仍將維持偏緊，但半導體業利潤率的擴張速度將於明年放緩。
高盛警告，若未來出現AI基礎建設投資降溫、晶片供給增加，或技術迭代壓低晶片價格等不利情境，標普500企業獲利可能受到明顯衝擊。依其估算，在上述情境下，標普500獲利恐縮水約10%。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs (GS-US) warned that the AI investment boom, while one of the main drivers of this year’s profit growth for US listed companies and contributing to almost half of the earnings increase among S&P 500 constituents, will start to erode profits as corporate capital‑expenditure growth slows and depreciation from large‑scale infrastructure investments rises, with this growth engine expected to gradually weaken from next year onward.

Even though UBS’s latest report estimates global AI investment to rise from close to $1 trillion this year to about $1.4 trillion next year, Goldman still believes that even as companies keep pouring money into data centers and chips, the profit‑boosting effect of the AI boom for US firms will noticeably cool.
AI infrastructure depreciation begins to erode profits

Goldman’s chief US equity strategist Ben Snider noted in a research note that, according to Goldman’s data, nearly 50% of the profit growth for S&P 500 companies in 2026 will stem from the AI investment boom.

However, as the pace of corporate cap‑ex slows and the depreciation from massive AI infrastructure spending starts to show up in financial statements, this favorable factor will begin to fade next year.

Snider said the AI boom contributed to almost half of this year’s profit growth for S&P 500 firms, but even if capital spending continues to expand, the related growth dividend will start to diminish next year.
In Goldman’s baseline scenario, US corporate profit growth will not come to a complete halt, but the pace will gradually decelerate.

Snider projects that earnings per share for S&P 500 constituents will grow 11% in both 2027 and 2028, reaching $415 and $460 respectively. Although double‑digit growth remains, it is a sharp slowdown from the 51% EPS surge in Q2 this year and the 26% average growth over the past four quarters.
Chip prices become profit risk for US stocks

Goldman sees the semiconductor sector as a major risk to US profit growth across industries. Since the AI surge at the end of 2022, semiconductors have been one of the main beneficiaries of big‑tech firms’ increased AI spending.
Supported by a surge in demand and constrained supply, global chip makers have enjoyed very high margins in recent years, but Goldman believes this situation is unlikely to persist long‑term.

Snider pointed out that the recent sharp rise in semiconductor margins makes S&P 500 earnings more vulnerable to a drop in chip prices. Goldman’s industry analysts estimate that chip supply will remain relatively tight through the end of 2027, but the pace of margin expansion in the semiconductor industry will slow next year.

Goldman warns that if AI infrastructure investment cools, chip supply expands, or technological cycles push chip prices lower, S&P 500 earnings could be hit noticeably. In such scenarios, Goldman estimates the index’s earnings could be trimmed by roughly 10%.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元升至近8周高點 歐元因德國政局受矚
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Rises to Near 8‑Week High; Euro in Focus Over German Politics
paras: 美元周一(19日)小幅走升，來到近8周高點，延續上周強勁漲勢，此前聯準會(Fed)進行了 3年多來首次升息。另一方面，日元在日本銀行(BoJ)決定收緊貨幣政策後，先前一波猛烈跌勢暫歇，歐元則因德國最新民調結果出爐而受矚。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報100.43，創7月29日以來最高。
本月市場最受關注議題之一，就是各大央行的升息行動。歐洲銀行(ECB)、聯準會與日本銀行近期都採取升息措施，且都提到了能源價格推動的通膨壓力。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上周在記者會上表示，「明確的事實就是通膨太高，而且已經持續太久。」
此前，聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率從3.50%-3.75%上調至 3.75%-4.00%。
此外，聯準會更新後的「經濟預測摘要」顯示，至少有12名FOMC委員認為今年還會再升息一次。
在FOMC做出升息決定之前，市場對聯準會升息的預期機率曾飆升至90%。推動市場預期的因素包括：油價急升、美國經濟數據，以及債券市場持續遭到拋售。尤其是固定收益市場投資人對這次升息反應正面，因他們認為這顯示聯準會沒有在通膨問題上落後於形勢。
Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management投資長Brent Schutte表示，「經濟的強勁表現，很可能就是聯準會認為可以升息的原因。但我們也提醒，升息的目的就是要放慢經濟成長速度。因此也會提高政策過度緊縮的風險，因為升息對經濟的影響延遲且不均。」
他進一步表示，「你們或許還記得，聯準會上一輪在2022年和2023年的升息，造成了經濟出現明顯分化。」當時，對利率較敏感的產業、企業及消費者面臨較大壓力，即使整體經濟仍持續成長。
歐元承受德國政治局勢轉變壓力
歐元兌美元下跌0.2%，至1歐元兌1.1463 美元。
歐洲交易市場正在消化周末公布的選舉預測結果。結果顯示，極右翼政黨「德國另類選擇黨」(AfD)在德國東北部的州選舉中取得領先。
這項具歷史意義的結果，直接打擊了德國總理梅爾茨(Friedrich Merz)領導的主流保守派聯盟，也讓歐洲股市面臨新的政治風險。
德銀的Jim Reid表示，「在極右派方面，AfD持續獲得更多支持，主要訴求包括反移民與反建制，尤其是在德國東部地區。」他也指出，左派政黨似乎則成功利用了民眾對住房負擔能力、生活成本以及社會不平等的擔憂。
他補充，「對市場而言，眼前最直接的影響並不是德國國家政策會立刻改變，而是德國政治中心進一步弱化，也再次提醒市場，推動歐洲政治兩極化的力量仍然存在。」
日元在升息、「利率檢查」後走弱
日元周一走弱，延續上周約2%猛烈跌勢。此前日銀公布利率決策後，日元跌至數周低點。
美元兌日元上漲0.3%，來到157.36日元。
日本金融市場周一因三天國定假期而休市。
由於假期期間流動性較低，全球交易員高度警戒日本政府可能進行外匯干預。過去在市場流動性不足的情況下，央行進場買進本國貨幣可能造成更大的價格波動。
讓市場對干預的擔憂進一步升高的是，《日本經濟新聞》上周五報導，日銀曾進行所謂的 「利率檢查」。這是指央行官員打電話給外匯交易部門，詢問市場上實際的買賣價。
日本銀行上周五將借貸成本提高至1.25%，創下31年來最高水準。
然而，兩名委員投下偏寬鬆政策的反對票，加上日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)強調政策需要進行預先性的調整，最初反而引發市場「利多出盡」反應。
這也迫使日本當局開始採取更積極的口頭警告及「利率檢查」，以支撐日元匯率。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Monday (the 19th), reaching a near‑8‑week high and continuing last week’s strong rally after the Federal Reserve delivered its first rate hike in more than three years. Meanwhile, the yen’s sharp slide eased after the Bank of Japan tightened policy, and the euro drew attention following the release of Germany’s latest poll results.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 100.43, its highest level since July 29.

One of the market’s top topics this month is the rate‑hike actions of major central banks. The European Central Bank, the Federal Reserve and the Bank of Japan have all recently raised rates and all cited inflation pressure from energy prices.
Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said at a press conference last week that “the clear fact is that inflation is too high and has been too persistent.”
Earlier, the Federal Open Market Committee voted unanimously to lift the federal funds rate range from 3.50‑3.75% to 3.75‑4.00%.
In addition, the Fed’s updated Summary of Economic Projections showed that at least 12 FOMC members expect another rate hike this year.

Before the FOMC’s decision, market expectations for a Fed hike had surged to 90%. Drivers of that expectation included a sharp rise in oil prices, U.S. economic data and continued bond‑market selling. Fixed‑income investors reacted positively, seeing the hike as evidence that the Fed is not lagging behind inflation pressures.

Brent Schutte, Chief Investment Officer at Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management, said, “The economy’s strong performance is likely why the Fed feels it can raise rates. But we remind that the purpose of tightening is to slow growth, which raises the risk of overtightening because the impact of rate hikes is delayed and uneven.”

He added, “You may recall the Fed’s previous tightening cycles in 2022‑2023 caused a clear split in the economy.” At that time, rate‑sensitive industries, firms and consumers felt heightened pressure even as overall growth continued.
Euro Under Pressure From Shifts in German Politics
The euro fell 0.2% against the dollar to $1.1463 per euro.
European markets are digesting the election‑forecast results released over the weekend, which showed the far‑right Alternative for Germany (AfD) leading in state elections in Germany’s northeast.
The historic outcome directly hit the mainstream conservative Union bloc led by Chancellor Friedrich Merz and added new political risk to European equities.

Jim Reid of Deutsche Bank said, “On the far‑right, the AfD is gaining more support, driven mainly by anti‑immigration and anti‑establishment messages, especially in eastern Germany.” He also noted that left‑wing parties seem to be capitalising on public concerns about housing affordability, living costs and social inequality.

He added, “For markets, the most immediate impact isn’t an immediate change in German national policy, but a further weakening of Germany’s political centre, reminding investors that forces driving European political polarisation remain present.”
Yen Weakens After Rate Hike and “Rate Check”
The yen weakened on Monday, extending last week’s roughly 2% plunge. Earlier, the yen fell to a multi‑week low after the BOJ announced its rate decision.
The dollar rose 0.3% against the yen to 157.36 yen.
Japan’s financial markets were closed on Monday for a three‑day national holiday.

Because liquidity is thin during the holiday, global traders are on high alert for possible foreign‑exchange intervention by the Japanese government. In past low‑liquidity episodes, central‑bank purchases of the domestic currency have amplified price swings.

Market worries about intervention were heightened after Nikkei reported last Friday that the BOJ had carried out a so‑called “rate check,” meaning officials called FX desks to ask about actual bid‑ask prices in the market.
The Bank of Japan raised its borrowing cost to 1.25% last Friday, the highest level in 31 years.

However, two board members cast votes for a more accommodative stance, and Governor Kazuo Ueda stressed that policy needed a pre‑emptive adjustment, initially prompting a “no‑more‑good‑news” reaction in the market.
That forced Japanese authorities to adopt more aggressive verbal warnings and conduct “rate checks” to support the yen’s exchange rate.
