items.title: 〈美股盤後〉那指大漲2%創收盤新高 AI股飆升、油價與美債殖利率降溫助攻
paras: 美國股市周一(21日)上漲，主要科技股走高，加上油價與美國公債殖利率回落，帶動華爾街從上周大多數指數下跌走勢中反彈。
大盤受到AI相關股票上漲的支撐，費城半導體指數漲逾4%。英特爾(INTC-US)股價大漲12%，AMD(AMD-US)漲近10%，市值達到1兆美元。其他晶片股也表現強勁，例如高通(QCOM-US)漲幅超過9%。
Meta更飆升11.4%。在近期推出Muse AI助理後，富國銀行調高了這家社群媒體公司的目標價，進一步推升股價。
美股周一走高的另一項助力，是美國原油價格大跌4.5%，來到每桶95.78 美元。布蘭特(Brent)原油則下跌3.4%，至每桶 100.34 美元。
油價變化發生在周末中東敵對局勢再度升級之後。獲伊朗支持的葉門武裝組織「青年運動」(Houthis)表示，他們周六以飛彈和無人機攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯。同日稍晚，美國國務院警告美國公民重新考慮前往中東地區旅行，因美國與伊朗相互威脅可能恢復攻擊。
不過，美國與伊朗近期仍有可能展開外交接觸。美國總統川普接受《福斯新聞》訪問時表示，本周聯合國大會期間，他可能願意與伊朗總統Masoud Pezeshkian會面。
隨著油價下跌，美國公債殖利率同步回落。10年期美國公債殖利率下降超過4個基點，來到4.951%。30年期美債殖利率也下降超過4個基點，至5.284%。
在美國持續面臨頑固通膨及債券殖利率居高不下情況下，聯準會(Fed)上周進行了三年來首次升息。CME的FedWatch數據顯示，交易員認為下個月再次升息的機率為 50%。
本周川普與中國國家主席習近平的峰會受國際關注。雙方預計將討論AI、關稅、關鍵礦產及其他經濟議題。美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)已在峰會前與中國國務院副總理何立峰會面。
另一方面，作為市場風險偏好重要指標的比特幣上漲超過6%，達到逾七個月新高，也帶動Coinbase(COIN-US)與Strategy(MSTR-US)股價走高。
美股周一(21日)主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG + 科技五天王全紅。Meta (META-US) 大漲11.43%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 上漲 0.85%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 上漲 1.55%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 上漲 1.59%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 上漲 1.87%。
費半成分股齊揚。輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 2.30%；博通 (AVGO-US) 上漲 1.60%；美光 (MU-US) 上漲 2.77%；高通 (QCOM-US) 大漲 9.29%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 勁揚4.42%；德儀 (TXN-US) 上漲 1.59%；AMD (AMD-US) 大漲 9.95%。
台股 ADR 多收漲。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 上漲 2.44%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 勁揚 5.04%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 上漲 3.33%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 持平。
企業新聞
AMD股價大漲近10%，收在615.52美元，推升市值首次突破1兆美元，成為第14家跨越這道門檻的美國企業，也是繼輝達、博通及美光後，第4家市值突破1兆美元的美國晶片商。相較一年前公司市值僅約2,550億美元，如今已成長近3倍。
美國財政部長貝森特表示，OpenAI先進人工智慧模型入侵Hugging Face事件，責任應由OpenAI管理階層承擔，不能歸咎於失控的AI代理，也不能期待聯邦政府為開發商提供責任豁免。
《路透社》引述消息人士報導，派拉蒙天舞(Paramount Skydance)(PSKY-US)已與加州及另外11個州達成和解。這些州原先提起訴訟，試圖阻止該公司與華納兄弟探索(Warner Bros. Discovery)之間價值1,100億美元的合併案。派拉蒙天舞股價下跌近3%。
華爾街分析
B. Riley Wealth首席市場策略師Art Hogan表示，「我們似乎已經習慣緊盯油價和美國10年期公債殖利率。如果看今天這兩項指標，它們至少在短期內，已經從股市的逆風轉變成順風。」
Yardeni Research總裁Ed Yardeni在報告中寫道，「能源價格在較長時間維持偏高，進一步增加了繼續緊縮貨幣政策的理由。」
Yardeni同時指出，供應面風險「並未消失」。中東衝突「持續威脅石油生產與航運，而烏克蘭對俄羅斯煉油廠的攻擊，以及針對俄國的制裁，也進一步限制了全球燃料供應。」並認為，「這波能源衝擊持續得越久，出現第二輪通膨效應的風險就越高。」
LPL Financial首席經濟學家Jeffrey Roach表示，「推高能源價格的地緣政治衝突，同時是讓聯準會維持鷹派立場、並對中國煉油業者造成壓力的因素。」
Roach表示，由聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)率領的委員會，「在通膨展望中，是以油市能夠逐漸穩定為前提，而北京的財政考量，同樣受到油價這項變數影響。」
數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主

items.title: 貝瑞再敲AI泡沫警鐘！五巨頭扛逾3兆美元表外承諾 「當音樂停止」恐變真負債
items.title_en: Burry Sounds Another AI Bubble Alarm! Five Cloud Giants Carry Over $3 Trillion in Off‑Balance‑Sheet Commitments; When the Music Stops, They Could Become Real Debt
paras: 電影《大賣空》真實原型、知名空頭投資人麥可貝瑞(Michael Burry)再次對人工智慧(AI)投資熱潮提出警告。他指出，亞馬遜、Meta、Alphabet、微軟與甲骨文五家超大規模雲端業者，已累積超過3兆美元的表外承諾與潛在財務義務，市場目前可能低估這些支出的實際風險。貝瑞強調，他並非指控企業存在詐欺，而是認為如果AI需求轉弱，部分目前尚未反映在資產負債表上的承諾，可能快速轉化為企業實際需要承擔的成本。
貝瑞在最新文章中指出，亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、Meta Platforms (META-US)、Alphabet (GOOGL-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)與甲骨文(ORCL-US)五家企業尚未開始執行的租賃承諾接近1.2兆美元，另外還有超過1.5兆美元的採購承諾。若再將特殊目的實體(SPV)、擔保、或有支持承諾及其他相關義務納入計算，整體金額超過3兆美元。
這些金額之所以受到關注，在於相關支出主要與AI資料中心、晶片、電力及其他基礎設施有關，而且許多承諾目前尚未以傳統負債形式直接出現在企業資產負債表上。摩根士丹利此前分析指出，五家超大規模雲端業者的未折現承諾合計超過2.7兆美元，約相當於這些企業目前營業現金流的3年規模；若再把輝達及博通納入更廣泛的AI供應鏈分析，相關表外承諾則超過3.1兆美元。
貝瑞認為，真正值得注意的是這些承諾的成長速度。他表示，相關負擔正處於「超高速成長」階段，增加速度可能快於企業自身的成長。市場目前主要關注科技巨頭每季公布的資本支出，但採購合約、資料中心租賃及其他長期承諾所代表的未來支出，可能遠高於單純觀察當期資本支出所得到的數字。
其中一項核心風險來自資料中心使用期限與AI硬體更新速度之間的落差。貝瑞指出，資料中心從規劃到完工可能需要3至5年，相關租約通常長達13至20年，但AI加速器的功率密度、散熱需求及晶片架構可能在12至18個月內出現重大變化。若AI晶片更新速度持續快於資料中心及相關基礎設施的更新週期，企業可能面臨設備快速失去經濟價值，但長期租賃與採購合約仍必須履行的問題。
這也是貝瑞特別關注AI資料中心資產折舊的原因。他指出，五家企業目前合計有超過4000億美元的在建工程資產，由於相關資產尚未投入使用，依一般公認會計原則(GAAP)目前尚不需要認列折舊。因此，財務報表上的折舊費用可能尚未反映這些AI基礎設施未來的經濟價值消耗。
貝瑞進一步質疑，AI伺服器與晶片的實際經濟壽命是否與企業會計上的折舊年限一致。他認為，部分AI硬體可能在尚未正式投入使用前，就已受到新一代晶片推出及技術迭代影響，形成所謂的「經濟折舊」。這與會計準則下資產何時開始折舊、以及企業如何設定資產使用年限，是兩個不同概念。
AI基礎設施的大量投入也讓企業未來的維護性資本支出成為另一項關注焦點。貝瑞認為，部分華爾街分析模型可能沒有充分反映AI基礎設施的維護成本及經濟折舊，若未來企業必須持續投入資金更新晶片、伺服器與資料中心設備，實際自由現金流可能受到更大壓力。
貝瑞尤其點名甲骨文。他認為，市場對甲骨文未來AI及雲端業務成長的預期相當高，部分華爾街分析師給予的平均目標價明顯高於當時市價，因此他認為市場可能低估了公司快速擴張AI基礎設施所伴隨的資本支出、融資與資產折舊風險。這是貝瑞對市場估值的個人判斷，並不代表華爾街分析師或甲骨文公司的共同看法。
貝瑞的警告也正值大型科技企業AI資本支出快速擴張之際。國際貨幣基金(IMF)今年4月曾估計，超大規模雲端業者到2029年與AI相關的資本支出可能累計達3.4兆美元，並指出若企業未來獲利與現金緩衝不足以支應這些支出，可能形成資產負債表壓力。IMF同時指出，自2025年1月以來，超大規模雲端業者已透過債券融資籌集超過1000億美元，此外還搭配槓桿貸款及企業間融資安排。
另一方面，AI相關融資並非全部由科技巨頭直接承擔。摩根士丹利指出，超大規模雲端業者可以利用自身較高的信用評級，透過長期租約、擔保及採購承諾，讓供應商與資料中心開發商提前取得融資，進而在科技巨頭尚未付款或尚未正式認列相關負債前，先行建設所需產能。這種融資模式使AI投資鏈條上的債務規模進一步擴大。
從企業揭露來看，Alphabet的採購及合約承諾尤其受到市場關注。摩根士丹利分析指出，Alphabet最新申報資料中的相關承諾金額約達8900億美元，在五家超大規模雲端業者中最高，且主要與採購承諾有關。Axios援引摩根士丹利資料則指出，Alphabet最新一季的採購承諾約7070億美元，遠高於2025年全年72.5億美元的水準。
不過，表外承諾並不能直接等同於3兆美元的「隱藏負債」。相關承諾通常代表企業未來可能需要支付的款項，但實際支出時間、金額及是否全部執行，仍取決於合約條件、設備交付、資料中心建設進度、需求變化以及其他商業安排。摩根士丹利也指出，目前仍難以完全確定這些承諾將在多長時間內轉化為實際支出，部分合約亦可能重新協商。
因此，貝瑞提出的核心問題並不是AI投資本身是否存在，而是當前AI基礎設施建設速度與企業未來現金流能否長期匹配。若AI需求維持強勁，雲端服務、AI模型及企業應用持續創造足夠收入，這些長期承諾可能逐步轉化為營收與現金流；但若需求成長放緩，企業可能同時面臨閒置資料中心、設備減損、合約終止成本以及持續維護支出。
貝瑞因此以「當音樂停止」作為警告，認為當AI需求與資本支出循環失去平衡時，目前位於資產負債表之外的承諾可能迅速轉化為實際財務負擔。屆時，企業除了可能面臨資產減損及終止合約成本，也可能因閒置產能增加而承受自由現金流與獲利能力的雙重壓力。
不過，目前大型雲端業者的AI需求仍維持強勁，微軟、Alphabet、亞馬遜及甲骨文持續擴大雲端與AI基礎設施投資，市場對AI算力、資料中心及相關設備的需求仍抱持高度期待。因此，貝瑞所提出的風險更接近對未來AI投資週期可能出現轉折的情境分析，而非對目前企業已陷入財務危機的判斷。
paras_en: Michael Burry, the famed short‑seller whose story inspired the movie "The Big Short," has again warned about the AI investment frenzy. He points out that the five mega‑scale cloud providers—Amazon, Meta, Alphabet, Microsoft and Oracle—have amassed more than $3 trillion in off‑balance‑sheet commitments and potential financial obligations, which the market may be underestimating in terms of actual risk. Burry stresses he is not accusing the firms of fraud, but believes that if AI demand weakens, some of these commitments not yet reflected on the balance sheet could quickly turn into real costs that companies must bear.

In his latest piece, Burry notes that the five firms—Amazon (AMZN‑US), Meta Platforms (META‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Oracle (ORCL‑US)—have roughly $1.2 trillion of lease commitments that have not yet been executed, plus over $1.5 trillion of procurement commitments. If special‑purpose vehicles, guarantees, contingent support commitments and other related obligations are added, the total exceeds $3 trillion.

These figures attract attention because the spending is tied mainly to AI data centers, chips, power and other infrastructure, and many of the commitments are not yet recorded as traditional debt on the companies’ balance sheets. Morgan Stanley previously estimated that the five mega‑cloud providers have undiscounted commitments totaling over $2.7 trillion, roughly three years of their current operating cash flow; when Nvidia and Broadcom are added to a broader AI‑supply‑chain view, off‑balance‑sheet commitments rise above $3.1 trillion.

Burry says the real issue is the speed at which these commitments are growing. He notes that the burden is in a “hyper‑fast growth” phase, potentially outpacing the firms’ own growth. Markets currently focus on quarterly capital‑expenditure disclosures, but future outlays represented by procurement contracts, data‑center leases and other long‑term commitments could be far higher than what current cap‑ex numbers suggest.

One core risk stems from the mismatch between data‑center lease terms and the rapid evolution of AI hardware. Burry points out that building a data center can take three to five years, with leases typically lasting 13 to 20 years, while AI accelerator power density, cooling needs and chip architecture can change dramatically within 12 to 18 months. If AI chip turnover stays faster than data‑center and infrastructure upgrades, firms may face equipment that quickly loses economic value while still being bound by long‑term lease and purchase contracts.

This is why Burry is especially focused on depreciation of AI data‑center assets. He says the five companies together have more than $400 billion in construction‑in‑progress assets, which under GAAP are not yet required to be depreciated because they are not in use. Consequently, depreciation expense on the financial statements may not yet reflect the future economic consumption of these AI infrastructures.

Burry further questions whether the actual economic life of AI servers and chips aligns with the depreciation periods set by corporate accounting. He argues that some AI hardware may become economically obsolete before it is even put into service due to newer chip generations and tech iterations, creating what he calls “economic depreciation,” a concept distinct from when accounting standards require an asset to start depreciating and how firms set useful‑life estimates.

The massive investment in AI infrastructure also makes future maintenance‑capex a new focus. Burry believes many Wall Street models may not fully capture the maintenance costs and economic depreciation of AI infrastructure; if firms must continually spend to upgrade chips, servers and data‑center equipment, free cash flow could come under greater pressure.

Burry singles out Oracle in particular. He says the market’s expectations for Oracle’s AI and cloud growth are very high, with some analysts’ average target prices well above current trading levels. He therefore believes the market may be under‑estimating the capital‑expenditure, financing and asset‑depreciation risks that accompany Oracle’s rapid AI‑infrastructure expansion. This is Burry’s personal view and does not represent the consensus of analysts or Oracle itself.

His warning comes as large‑tech AI cap‑ex is expanding rapidly. The International Monetary Fund estimated in April that mega‑cloud providers could collectively spend $3.4 trillion on AI‑related cap‑ex by 2029, and warned that if future earnings and cash buffers are insufficient, balance‑sheet pressure could mount. The IMF also noted that since January 2025, these providers have raised over $100 billion through bond issuances, supplemented by leveraged loans and inter‑company financing arrangements.

On the other hand, AI‑related financing is not borne entirely by the tech giants themselves. Morgan Stanley says the mega‑cloud providers can leverage their high credit ratings to secure financing for suppliers and data‑center developers via long‑term leases, guarantees and purchase commitments, allowing capacity to be built before the giants actually pay or record the liabilities. This financing structure further inflates debt exposure along the AI investment chain.

Looking at disclosures, Alphabet’s procurement and contract commitments have drawn particular market attention. Morgan Stanley’s analysis shows Alphabet’s latest filings indicate commitments of about $890 billion—the highest among the five mega‑cloud firms—and mainly tied to procurement. Axios, citing Morgan Stanley, reports Alphabet’s most recent quarter procurement commitments at roughly $707 billion, far above the $7.25 billion annual level projected for 2025.

However, off‑balance‑sheet commitments should not be equated directly with $3 trillion of “hidden debt.” Such commitments represent potential future payments, but the timing, amount and whether they will be fully executed depend on contract terms, equipment delivery, data‑center construction progress, demand shifts and other commercial arrangements. Morgan Stanley also notes that it remains difficult to determine how quickly these commitments will turn into actual outlays, and some contracts may be renegotiated.

Thus, Burry’s core concern is not whether AI investment itself is flawed, but whether the current pace of AI infrastructure build‑out can be sustainably matched by future cash flows. If AI demand stays strong, cloud services, AI models and enterprise applications will continue to generate sufficient revenue and cash, allowing long‑term commitments to gradually become revenue and cash‑flow contributors. If demand growth slows, firms could face idle data centers, equipment impairments, contract termination costs and ongoing maintenance expenses.

Burry uses the phrase “when the music stops” as a warning, suggesting that if AI demand and cap‑ex cycles lose balance, the off‑balance‑sheet commitments could swiftly become real financial burdens. At that point, companies may suffer asset impairments, contract‑termination costs, and dual pressure on free cash flow and profitability from idle capacity.

Nevertheless, AI demand remains robust for the major cloud players. Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Oracle continue to expand cloud and AI infrastructure investments, and the market maintains high expectations for AI compute, data‑center capacity and related equipment. Consequently, Burry’s risk scenario is more of a forward‑looking analysis of a potential inflection point in the AI investment cycle rather than an assertion that these firms are currently in a financial crisis.

items.title: 市場恐誤判！德銀示警：終點利率恐遠超預期　升息未必導致股市下跌
items.title_en: Market Misjudgment! Deutsche Bank Warns: Terminal Rates May Far Exceed Expectations, Rate Hikes Not Necessarily Triggering Stock Market Decline
paras: 德意志銀行宏觀策略師Henry Allen最新指出，隨著Fed、歐洲央行、日本央行過去兩週相繼升息，全球主要央行已進入同步緊縮階段，但市場仍可能低估本輪週期最終會走多遠。市場誤判關鍵不在「會不會繼續升息」，而在終點利率需要升到多高、維持多久。
德銀列出四項支撐判斷的依據；一，大宗商品壓力尚未完全傳導。布蘭特原油目前約在每桶100美元，其他大宗商品價格也普遍上行，而這部分成本壓力尚未充分反映在通膨數據與調查指標。能源衝擊也可能透過運輸、生產與服務價格形成二次傳導，令通膨回落更加困難。
二，決策官員對物價風險的敏感度已顯著提升。2022年，全球主要央行至通膨升破8%後才大規模行動，如今經歷上一輪衝擊，反應函數明顯前置。Fed主席華許也承認，過去五年多美國通膨持續高於目標水準。
三，金融條件仍相對寬鬆。標普500指數接近歷史高位，信用利差處於較低水平，意味著市場尚未形成足夠的緊縮約束。若資產價格與融資條件持續強勢，央行恐需要更多升息才能真正壓低需求。
四，歷史經驗指向單向誤判。德銀舉例指出，2022年初投資人僅計入Fed首年約200個基點的升息幅度，最終實際升息超過400個基點，市場幾乎總是低估而非高估週期幅度。
德銀同時提示，較深週期的尾部風險不等於股市必然大跌。若經濟成長保持強勁，企業獲利可在一定程度上抵銷估值壓力。
德銀以1999年為例指出，當年Fed持續升息、美債殖利率上行，標普500指數全年仍上漲近20%。
paras_en: Deutsche Bank macro strategist Henry Allen recently noted that as the Fed, the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan have all raised rates in the past two weeks, the world’s major central banks have entered a synchronized tightening phase, yet the market may still be underestimating how far this cycle’s end point will go. The mis‑judgment is not about whether rates will keep rising, but about how high the terminal rate will need to be and how long it will stay there.

Deutsche Bank lists four bases for its view. First, commodity pressure has not yet been fully transmitted. Brent crude is around $100 a barrel and other commodity prices are generally rising, but this cost pressure has not been fully reflected in inflation data and survey indicators. Energy shocks can also feed through transport, production and service prices, making it harder for inflation to ease.

Second, policymakers’ sensitivity to price risks has risen sharply. In 2022, the world’s major central banks only acted on a large scale after inflation broke above 8%. Having gone through the previous shock, the response function is now clearly front‑loaded. Fed Chair Jerome Powell also acknowledged that for more than five years U.S. inflation has stayed above target.

Third, financial conditions remain relatively loose. The S&P 500 is near historic highs and credit spreads are at low levels, indicating that the market has not yet developed sufficient tightening constraints. If asset prices and financing conditions stay strong, central banks may need more rate hikes to truly curb demand.

Fourth, historical experience points to a one‑sided mis‑judgment. Deutsche Bank cites that at the start of 2022 investors only accounted for about 200 basis points of Fed hikes in the first year, while the actual cumulative hikes exceeded 400 basis points – markets almost always underestimate rather than overestimate the cycle’s magnitude.

Deutsche Bank also cautions that deeper cycle tail‑risk does not automatically mean a stock market crash. If economic growth stays robust, corporate earnings can offset valuation pressure to some extent.
Using 1999 as an example, Deutsche Bank notes that despite the Fed’s continued rate hikes and rising U.S. Treasury yields that year, the S&P 500 still posted nearly a 20% gain for the full year.

items.title: 川習會前有新大單？波音先替市場期待降溫
items.title_en: New big order before Trump‑Xi meeting? Boeing tempers market expectations
paras: 美國貿易代表葛里爾(Jamieson Greer)周一(21日)表示，中國正在推進今年5月宣布採購200架波音(BA-US)飛機的承諾，但他並未暗示，在美國總統川普與中國國家主席習近平本周會晤前，中方即將公布額外訂單。
葛里爾接受《福斯新聞》(Fox News)訪問時表示，供中國航空公司採購的波音飛機中，約140架目前「進展良好」，另有10架正在把採購內容落實為書面訂單。不過，他並未進一步說明其餘飛機的談判進度或交付時間。
川普5月曾表示，中國最終可能把波音採購規模擴大至最多750架，引發市場期待本周美中領袖會晤期間可能公布追加訂單。
不過，波音執行長歐特柏格(Kelly Ortberg)上周淡化相關預期。他表示，未來仍可能陸續增加訂單，但將由各家航空公司依照自身步調決定何時及如何對外宣布。歐特柏格5月曾形容，中國承諾採購的200架飛機只是潛在大型交易的「首批訂單」。
paras_en: US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said on Monday (21st) that China is moving forward with its commitment announced in May to purchase 200 Boeing (BA-US) aircraft, but he did not indicate that China will announce an additional order before the meeting this week between US President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping.

In an interview with Fox News, Greer said that of the Boeing planes intended for Chinese airlines, about 140 are currently “progressing well,” and another 10 are being formalized into written orders. However, he did not provide further details on the negotiation status or delivery timeline for the remaining aircraft.

In May, Trump said China could eventually expand the Boeing purchase to as many as 750 aircraft, fueling market hopes that an extra order might be announced during this week’s US‑China leaders’ summit.

Boeing CEO Kelly Ortberg downplayed those expectations last week. He said that additional orders may still come over time, but each airline will decide on its own schedule when and how to announce them publicly. Ortberg had described in May that the 200‑aircraft commitment from China was only the “first batch” of a potentially large deal.

items.title: 輝達升逾2% 川普與中國談判可望推動進一步上漲
items.title_en: Nvidia Rises Over 2% as Trump‑China Talks Could Spur Further Gains
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，輝達(NVDA-US)正尋找能推動股價再次挑戰歷史新高的催化因素。本周美國總統川普與中國國家主席習近平的峰會，可能正是它需要的契機。
輝達股價周一(21日)收在227.38美元，漲幅2.3%。截至周一交易開始前，今年以來已上漲約19%，但目前仍低於5月14日創下的歷史收盤高點235.74美元。
對輝達而言，最理想情況就是川普與習近平能夠在AI發展方面達成協議，進而全面解除對輝達向中國銷售AI晶片的限制。
輝達執行長黃仁勳上周五接受CBS News訪問時表示，「美國已經做出決定，而我非常支持這項決定，我們應該優先讓美國企業取得輝達最好的技術。」
不過，黃仁勳也表示，他不同意全面禁止向中國企業銷售晶片，並認為美國供應商「應該在全球市場競爭」。
川普政府先前表示，將允許輝達向經過批准的中國客戶出貨H200 AI晶片。H200 的效能不如目前的Blackwell AI晶片，而且與即將推出的Vera Rubin系列相比，實際上已落後好幾代。輝達也同意，未來將把相關銷售收入的25%分給美國政府。
儘管H200有性能上的限制，中國企業仍可能願意購買約150萬顆H200處理器。據KeyBanc分析師John Vinh，這相當於約300億美元的營收。而輝達估計，中國市場對其晶片而言，整體潛在市場規模(TAM)約為500億美元。
不過，目前限制H200出貨的主要障礙其實來自中國政府。截至目前，中國只允許相對少量的H200晶片進口，原因之一是中方擔心，如果大量使用輝達晶片，可能會讓中國自身AI生態系過度依賴外國供應商。《金融時報》8月曾援引知情人士報導，中國政府已允許字節跳動與騰訊各自取得約1萬顆輝達H200處理器。
根據《華爾街日報》，黃仁勳預計將出席川普周四為習近平舉行的國宴。在AI議題上，黃仁勳通常與川普政府的方向一致，但如果輝達希望真正取得大規模對中國出貨的機會，可能需要這次峰會最終達成一項大型的美中AI合作協議。
另一方面，輝達高層仍持續從公司的巨大成功中獲益。根據監管文件，輝達財務長 Colette Kress在9月17日出售34,918股股票，價值約765萬美元。
這些交易是依10b5-1預先設定交易計畫執行。這類交易計畫會事先設定特定條件，例如股價達到某個價格或到達特定日期，一旦條件符合，就會觸發股票交易。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reports that Nvidia (NVDA‑US) is seeking a catalyst to push its stock back to a new all‑time high. This week’s summit between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping may be the opportunity it needs.

Nvidia’s share price closed at $227.38 on Monday (the 21st), up 2.3%. By the start of Monday’s trading it had risen about 19% year‑to‑date, but it still sits below the historic closing high of $235.74 set on May 14.
The ideal scenario for Nvidia would be for Trump and Xi to reach an agreement on AI development that would fully lift restrictions on Nvidia’s sales of AI chips to China.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told CBS News last Friday, “The United States has made a decision, and I fully support that decision. We should prioritize getting the best Nvidia technology into American companies.”
However, Huang also said he does not agree with a blanket ban on selling chips to Chinese firms and believes U.S. suppliers “should compete in the global market.”

The Trump administration previously said it would allow Nvidia to ship its H200 AI chips to approved Chinese customers. The H200 is less powerful than the current Blackwell AI chip and, compared with the upcoming Vera Rubin series, is actually several generations behind. Nvidia also agreed to remit 25% of the related sales revenue to the U.S. government.

Even with its performance limits, Chinese companies may still be willing to buy about 1.5 million H200 processors. KeyBanc analyst John Vinh estimates that equates to roughly $30 billion in revenue. Nvidia estimates the total addressable market (TAM) for its chips in China at about $50 billion.

The main obstacle to shipping H200 chips now actually comes from the Chinese government. So far China has allowed only a relatively small amount of H200 imports, partly because officials fear that large‑scale use of Nvidia chips could make China’s own AI ecosystem overly dependent on foreign suppliers. The Financial Times cited sources in August saying the Chinese government has permitted ByteDance and Tencent each to obtain about 10,000 Nvidia H200 processors.

According to the Wall Street Journal, Huang expects to attend the state dinner Trump will host for Xi on Thursday. On AI issues Huang usually aligns with the Trump administration’s stance, but if Nvidia wants a truly large‑scale shipping opportunity to China, it may need a major US‑China AI cooperation agreement to emerge from the summit.
Meanwhile, Nvidia executives continue to benefit from the company’s massive success. Regulatory filings show that CFO Colette Kress sold 34,918 shares on September 17, worth roughly $7.65 million.

These trades were executed under a pre‑established 10b5‑1 trading plan, which sets specific conditions—such as a target stock price or date—in advance, and triggers the transaction automatically once those conditions are met.

items.title: AI推升資料中心用電需求 澳洲2035年占主電網供電比重估達13%
items.title_en: AI Boosts Data Center Power Demand; Australia's Share of Main Grid Supply Projected to Reach 13% by 2035
paras: 2026年09月22日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI快速發展帶動資料中心規模與用電需求攀升，澳洲目前已有超過160座資料中心營運，另有至少90座正在開發規劃中。預估至2030年，澳洲資料中心建設投資規模將達1,500億澳元。
資料中心並非新興產業，早期主要支援企業IT系統，之後隨網路、雲端運算發展，逐步轉向大型共置及超大型資料中心。2025年，超大型資料中心業者已占全球資料中心容量48%。
近年AI成為新一波需求來源。AI模型訓練需要大量高效能晶片同時運算，模型投入使用後的AI推論同樣需要持續投入運算資源。預估到2030年，AI將占資料中心需求約70%。
澳洲規劃中的資料中心也朝大型化發展。以雪梨Mamre Road Data Centre為例，規劃電力容量達1.2 GW，占地約相當於52座橄欖球場，若完全建成，將成為澳洲最大的單一用電戶。
儘管大型資料中心的能源使用效率較高，但整體用電需求仍快速增加。澳洲企業自建伺服器執行相同運算所需電力，估計超過超大型及共置資料中心的7倍。不過，資料中心在2025至2026年度已占澳洲主要電網供電量約3%，預估2035至2036年度將升至13%。
隨著用電、用水及土地需求增加，澳洲政府正著手加強管理。澳洲國家內閣8月重申，計畫在2027年初前制定全國一致的大型資料中心強制標準，涵蓋能源、用水及土地使用等要求。

paras_en: September 22, 2026 (U-Analysis / Industry Data Center Report) – Rapid AI development is driving the expansion of data centers and their electricity consumption. Australia already operates more than 160 data centers, with at least another 90 in development or planning. Investment in data center construction is expected to reach AUD 150 billion by 2030.

Data centers are not a new industry; they originally mainly supported corporate IT systems. With the growth of the internet and cloud computing, they have gradually shifted toward large colocation facilities and hyperscale data centers. By 2025, hyperscale operators accounted for 48% of global data center capacity.

In recent years, AI has become a fresh source of demand. Training AI models requires massive high‑performance chips operating in parallel, and once deployed, AI inference also continuously consumes compute resources. It is estimated that by 2030 AI will represent about 70% of data center demand.

Australia’s planned data centers are also moving toward larger scales. For example, the Mamre Road Data Centre in Sydney is being designed with a power capacity of 1.2 GW and will cover an area roughly equivalent to 52 rugby fields. If fully built, it will become the country’s largest single electricity consumer.

Although large data centers are more energy‑efficient, overall power demand is still rising quickly. Power needed for Australian enterprises to run the same workloads on in‑house servers is estimated to be more than seven times that of hyperscale and colocation facilities. Nevertheless, data centers already accounted for about 3% of Australia’s main grid supply in the 2025‑2026 fiscal year, and this share is projected to rise to 13% in the 2035‑2036 period.

With growing needs for electricity, water, and land, the Australian government is tightening management. In August, the national cabinet reaffirmed plans to establish a nationwide mandatory standard for large data centers by early 2027, covering energy, water, and land‑use requirements.

items.title: 看清美國無能為力！FT：波斯灣國家大夢初醒  齊呼「重置」對伊朗關係
items.title_en: Seeing the U.S.'s Powerlessness! FT: Gulf Nations Awaken from a Grand Dream, Call for a “Reset” of Relations with Iran
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，美以兩國聯手攻打伊朗數個月後，波斯灣國家正重新評估「靠華府保安全」的模式。
英國《金融時報》報導，卡達、阿聯在聯合國大會期間先後呼籲擴大與伊朗直接對話，沙烏地阿拉伯則與盟友研究包括互不侵犯安排在內的區域安全構想，顯示波灣國家試圖把伊朗納入一套可約束風險、而非僅靠美軍威懾的機制。
卡達首相兼外交大臣穆罕默德在紐約表示，美對伊戰事是對波斯灣的「警醒」，區域安全不能建立在任一國不安全的基礎上，應建立涵蓋海灣與伊朗的框架，避免相互威脅。
阿聯總統外交顧問加爾加什同樣主張，阿拉伯國家須與伊朗直接溝通。「美伊談判進展有限，穩定中東不能只由華府與德黑蘭決定。」
美伊開戰初期，阿聯曾遭大量導彈與無人機射向本土，阿布達比一度空襲伊朗，其後轉向降溫，以保金融、貿易與旅遊。
沙國壓力來自葉門胡塞武裝組織，近期持續遭後者飛彈、無人機攻擊，並威脅曼德與紅海航線。沙國曾希望美軍直接打胡塞，但川普政府迄今未全盤接受。
知情人士分析指出，沙國自開戰以來與盟友研議中東國家與伊朗訂互不侵犯安排，查塔姆研究所中東主任瓦基爾解讀，波斯灣國家領袖正面對「外部保護傘不再絕對可靠、對伊關係又持續緊張」的雙重局面，因此更想自己設計安全規則。
經濟是另一推力。荷姆茲海峽關係沙特、阿聯、卡達能源出口；戰事期間襲船與保險成本上升，迫使業者改道或重估運力。沙國原本以東西輸油管線把原油送至紅海延布港、減少依賴荷姆茲海峽，但管線部分設施遇襲關閉後，替代通道受限。
根據《彭博資訊》最新數據，沙國近期增加經波斯灣、荷姆茲出口，周末停靠波斯灣設施、具約1400萬桶裝載能力的油輪數增至6月以來高位。 這種「本想繞開、又被逼回海峽」的結構，使得波斯灣更有動機與伊朗談航運與降級。
9月聯合國大會則成新一輪接觸窗口。卡達持續在美伊之間斡旋，雙方雖未恢復直接談判，中間管道仍在；伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚、外長阿拉格齊預定赴紐約與會，伊朗總統預計周三(23日)在聯大發言。期間，美國總土川普將在紐約會晤波斯灣六國領袖，討論伊朗戰事下一步與戰後安排。
美國駐聯合國大使沃爾茲稱川普聯大講話將談到防止伊朗擁核。川普周日也向《福斯新聞》表示「可能」會佩澤希齊揚，但雙方尚無正式會談確認。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that months after the U.S. and Israel jointly attacked Iran, Gulf states are re‑evaluating the model of “relying on Washington for security.”

The Financial Times says Qatar and the United Arab Emirates, during the UN General Assembly, each urged expanded direct dialogue with Iran, while Saudi Arabia and its allies are studying regional‑security concepts that include non‑aggression pacts, showing Gulf states are trying to bring Iran into a risk‑mitigating framework rather than relying solely on U.S. military deterrence.

Qatar’s prime minister and foreign minister Mohammed said in New York that the U.S.–Iran war is a “wake‑up call” for the Gulf and that regional security cannot be built on any one country’s insecurity; a framework covering both the Gulf and Iran is needed to avoid mutual threats.

UAE presidential adviser Al‑Gharashi likewise argued that Arab states must communicate directly with Iran, noting “U.S.–Iran talks have made limited progress, and Middle‑East stability cannot be left to Washington and Tehran alone.”

In the early days of the U.S.–Iran conflict, the UAE was hit by a large volley of missiles and drones, prompting Abu Dhabi to launch an air strike on Iran before shifting to de‑escalation to protect its finance, trade and tourism sectors.

Saudi pressure comes from Yemen’s Houthi rebels, which have recently launched missiles and drones against Saudi targets and threatened the Bab al‑Mandab and Red Sea shipping lanes; Riyadh had hoped the U.S. would strike the Houthis directly, but the Trump administration has not fully embraced that option.

Informed sources say Saudi Arabia has been discussing a non‑aggression arrangement with Iran and other Middle‑East states since the war began. Waqir, director of the Middle‑East program at the Chatham Institute, interprets this as Gulf leaders facing a “dual dilemma” of an increasingly unreliable external security umbrella and persistently tense ties with Iran, prompting them to craft their own safety rules.

Economics is another driver. The Strait of Hormuz is vital for Saudi, UAE and Qatari energy exports; war‑time attacks on vessels and higher insurance costs have forced shippers to reroute or reassess capacity. Saudi Arabia had tried to shift crude to the Red Sea port of Yanbu via east‑west pipelines to reduce reliance on Hormuz, but parts of the pipeline were hit and shut, limiting alternative routes.

Bloomberg data show Saudi Arabia recently increased exports through the Gulf and Hormuz, with the number of tankers capable of loading about 14 million barrels at Gulf facilities rising to its highest level since June. This “intended‑to‑bypass‑but‑forced‑back‑into‑the‑strait” situation gives the Gulf more incentive to negotiate shipping and de‑escalation with Iran.

The September UN General Assembly provides a new window for contact. Qatar continues to mediate between the U.S. and Iran; although direct talks have not resumed, back‑channel links remain. Iran’s President Raisi and Foreign Minister Amir‑Abdollahian are slated to attend the New York session, with Raisi expected to speak on Wednesday the 23rd. Meanwhile, U.S. President Trump will meet the six Gulf leaders in New York to discuss the next steps in the Iran war and post‑war arrangements.

U.S. Ambassador to the UN Linda Thomas‑Greenfield said Trump’s UN speech will address preventing Iran from acquiring a nuclear weapon. Trump also told Fox News on Sunday that a “possible” meeting with President Raisi is on the table, though no formal talks have been confirmed.

items.title: 英特爾大漲12%安謀飆17% Meta AI代理Muse點燃晶片股漲勢
items.title_en: Intel Jumps 12% as Arm Soars 17% on Meta AI Agent Muse Fueling Chip Rally
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，英特爾(INTC-US)、AMD(AMD-US)與安謀(ARM-US)股價周一(21日)大幅上漲，投資人愈加看好CPU的潛在成長空間。這波行情的催化劑，似乎是 Meta Platforms(META-US)推出的 Muse人工智慧代理受到市場歡迎。
這波漲勢推動AMD收盤時的市值達到1兆美元，成為第14家達到這項里程碑的美國企業。
AMD股價周一上漲9.9%，收在615.52美元。根據道瓊市場數據，這也是AMD自6月30日以來首次創下歷史新高的收盤價。
英特爾股價與安謀的ADR股價漲幅更大，分別上漲12%與17%。
今年初，由於市場看好AI服務對CPU的需求，英特爾與安謀股價曾經歷一波強勁上漲，但進入夏季後半段，兩者股價又回落。
如今Muse AI代理的早期成功重新點燃了市場熱情。根據Sensor Tower，Muse過去三天一直是美國iPhone App Store下載量最高的免費應用程式。
AI代理的一項重要特性，就是可以自主執行任務。這類AI代理的普及可能大幅增加晶片在推論方面的需求，而這項工作不只需要GPU，也需要大量的CPU。英特爾執行長陳立武上周表示，公司目前只能滿足客戶大約50%的需求。
安謀預估，伺服器CPU市場每年可以成長超過35%，到2030年市場規模將達到1,200億美元。
AMD則更加樂觀。該公司預估，伺服器 CPU市場到2030年可能成長50%，創造約2,200億美元的營收機會。
AI代理今年已出現過一次引起市場關注的熱潮，其中包括開源AI助理專案 OpenClaw爆紅。不過，對沒有技術背景的使用者而言，OpenClaw的設定可能比較複雜，而且其主要開發者之後被OpenAI延攬。相比之下，Muse更容易讓一般使用者使用，且Meta擁有更多開發人員，可以投入資源持續改善Muse功能。
KeyBanc分析師Justin Patterson在報告中寫道，「我們認為，Meta的分發能力與數據優勢，讓Muse從第一天開始就具備優勢。如果Muse能在未來幾個月建立起數億人的每月活躍用戶群，而理想情況下甚至能形成數億人的每周活躍或日活躍用戶群，市場應該會視其為成功。」
當然，Muse仍面臨一些障礙。亞馬遜(AMZN-US)已經阻止Meta的Muse AI代理在其網站上進行購物。亞馬遜表示，Meta在讓Muse取得其平台存取權限之前，並沒有事先告知相關計畫。
亞馬遜發言人在聲明中表示，「我們認為，第三方應用程式如果提供代表消費者向其他企業進行購買的服務，就應該以公開的方式運作，並尊重服務提供商是否選擇參與的決定。像Muse這樣的代理型第三方應用程式，也必須遵守相同義務。我們已要求Meta將亞馬遜從這項體驗中移除。」
不過，這家電子商務巨頭甚至需要採取這樣的措施，本身就凸顯出Muse正在快速普及。而如果AI代理的市場真的持續蓬勃發展，CPU的需求也將同步增加——這對英特爾、安謀與AMD而言都是好消息。
Partners分析師Ivan Feinseth近期將英特爾 的目標價從118美元上調至145美元，同時維持買進評級。
Feinseth寫道，「AI正重新提升英特爾x86 CPU業務的重要性，因為推論、代理型AI、資料協調、網路及企業工作負載，都需要大量的一般用途運算能力，同時搭配加速運算。」
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that Intel (INTC-US), AMD (AMD-US) and Arm (ARM-US) saw their stocks surge on Monday the 21st, as investors grew more optimistic about the growth potential of CPUs. The catalyst appears to be Meta Platforms’ (META-US) Muse AI agent, which has been well received by the market.
The rally pushed AMD’s market value to $1 trillion at the close, making it the 14th U.S. company to reach that milestone.
AMD’s shares rose 9.9% on Monday, closing at $615.52. According to Dow Jones market data, this was also AMD’s first all‑time high closing price since June 30.
Intel’s stock and Arm’s ADR posted even larger gains, up 12% and 17% respectively.
Earlier this year, buoyed by expectations that AI services would drive CPU demand, Intel and Arm enjoyed a strong price run‑up, but their shares fell back in the second half of summer.
Now the early success of the Muse AI agent has reignited market enthusiasm. Sensor Tower says Muse has been the top‑downloaded free app in the U.S. iPhone App Store for the past three days.

A key feature of AI agents is autonomous task execution. Widespread adoption could sharply raise chip demand for inference, which requires not only GPUs but also large amounts of CPU power. Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger said last week the company can currently meet only about 50% of customer demand.
Arm estimates the server‑CPU market can grow more than 35% annually, reaching a $120 billion size by 2030.
AMD is even more bullish, projecting the server‑CPU market could grow 50% by 2030, creating roughly $220 billion of revenue opportunity.

AI agents have already sparked a market‑making wave this year, notably the open‑source assistant project OpenClaw. However, OpenClaw’s setup can be complex for non‑technical users and its lead developer was later recruited by OpenAI. By contrast, Muse is easier for the average user, and Meta has a larger developer pool to continuously improve Muse’s features.

KeyBanc analyst Justin Patterson wrote in a note, “We believe Meta’s distribution capability and data advantage give Muse a head‑start from day one. If Muse can build a monthly active user base of hundreds of millions in the coming months, and ideally hundreds of millions of weekly or daily active users, the market will view it as a success.”
Muse still faces hurdles. Amazon (AMZN-US) has blocked Meta’s Muse AI agent from shopping on its site, saying Meta did not inform Amazon in advance before seeking platform access for Muse.

An Amazon spokesperson said, “We believe third‑party apps that act on behalf of consumers to purchase from other businesses should operate transparently and respect the service provider’s choice to participate. Agent‑type third‑party apps like Muse must meet the same obligations. We have asked Meta to remove Amazon from this experience.”

Nevertheless, the fact that the e‑commerce giant feels the need to take such action underscores how quickly Muse is gaining traction. If the AI‑agent market continues to expand, CPU demand will rise in tandem – good news for Intel, Arm and AMD.
Partners analyst Ivan Feinseth recently raised Intel’s price target from $118 to $145 while maintaining a buy rating.

Feinseth wrote, “AI is re‑elevating the importance of Intel’s x86 CPU business because inference, agent‑type AI, data orchestration, networking and enterprise workloads all need massive general‑purpose compute, complemented by accelerators.”

items.title: 高油價+美債殖利率飆漲壓縮財政空間！IEA：全球94國出手補貼油價
items.title_en: High Oil Prices and US Treasury Yields Squeeze Fiscal Space! IEA: 94 Countries Subsidize Oil Prices
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，高油價衝擊正從加油站與家庭帳單，快速滲入各國主權財政。根據國際能源署(IEA)最新數據，全球實施直接燃料補貼的國家已由四個月前的16個增加至38個，調降能源稅國家由40個增至57個，推出某種消費者能源支援措施的國家達94個。隨著補貼網越鋪越大，政府承擔的價格緩衝成本也越重。
問題在於這輪干預恰逢全球融資環境緊縮；美國政府借款成本升至2007年以來高位，通膨與升息共同推高主權融資利率，能源補貼、債務利息開始擠占同一塊預算。
IMF等機構持續主張，能源支援應針對弱勢、短期化；普遍補貼若遇上油價長期居高不下，很容易由臨時救急變成長期財政負擔。
歐洲首當其衝。法國已延長原定9月底退場的高里程駕駛補助；德國總理默爾茨亦稱將盡快提出協助司機對抗高燃油成本方案；英國則面臨擴大低收入家庭能源支援的壓力。
英國能源監管機構Ofgem已確認下月典型家庭雙燃料帳單上調4%，年上限約1723英鎊。供應商EDF預估，若批發價格持續高位，明年1月還可能再漲26%，最終增幅取決於11月中前天然氣與電力批發價。
此外，歐洲入冬天然氣庫存又處低位，儲氣設施正常可滿足歐盟冬季約三分之一用氣，庫存不足使未來批發氣價與潛在補貼更受供需牽動。
一些分析人士認為，按當前補庫速度，要到75%低標都未必容易。法國總統馬克宏表示，G7未來數周將討論進一步釋出戰略石油與燃料儲備，若能壓低油價，可間接減輕補貼壓力。
但債市正在壓縮政策空間。歐盟已就主權債務殖利率「明顯上升」提出警告，要求成員國堅守中期財政目標，歐盟內部同時討論能源暴利稅，但委員會對全歐統一課稅態度審慎，成員國可自訂。
對政府而言，能源支援擴張等於同時支付兩筆帳：一邊補居民與企業，一邊以更高利率發債，財政降油價的能力日益受到公債成本約束。
亞洲則在補貼與削減補貼之間重新權衡。印尼承諾維持燃料補貼，馬來西亞以不同機制穩價，泰國自3月逐步退場；財政空間與油價耐受度不同，路徑便不同。
孟加拉周一(21日)把柴油由每升115塔卡調至135塔卡，汽油、煤油同步走漲，最高漲幅17.4%。孟國能源部指出，國際油價自3月以來漲逾一倍、運輸成本受地緣局勢推高，3至8月國有石油公司累虧2287.6億塔卡、約19億美元，新價可年減虧約1000億塔卡並省外匯。
拉美則呈兩極。巴西Petrobras上週加入新柴油補貼，每升1雷亞爾並可與既有每升1.12雷亞爾補助疊加。該公司披露柴油、汽油、液化石油氣相關補貼累計約99億雷亞爾，財政繼續硬扛。
玻利維亞在參議院通過19億美元IMF貸款後取消柴油補貼，改按國際價統一訂價；政府稱油氣補貼年支出約26億美元，多邊貸款不會再用於「高價進、低價出」，新方案要求削支出並在2027年前全面取消燃料補貼，但保留現金補助、優惠融資、部分進口稅減免與就業支持。
整體來看，高油價已把能源政策推向財政抉擇：補貼可短期壓帳單，卻會擴大赤字、推高發債成本；退出補貼可穩收支，卻把價格直接還給選民。冬季氣價、中東供應與債券收益率三者如何演變，將決定各國從「臨時緩衝」走向「長期負擔」還是「改革退場」。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that soaring oil prices are hitting gas stations and household bills, quickly spilling into sovereign finances worldwide. According to the International Energy Agency (IEA), the number of countries providing direct fuel subsidies has risen from 16 four months ago to 38, the number cutting energy taxes has grown from 40 to 57, and 94 countries now have some form of consumer energy support. As the subsidy net expands, governments bear heavier price‑buffer costs.

The problem is that this round of intervention coincides with a tightening global financing environment; U.S. government borrowing costs have risen to their highest level since 2007, and inflation together with rate hikes have pushed sovereign financing rates up, so energy subsidies and debt interest are crowding the same budget line.

Institutions such as the IMF continue to argue that energy support should target the vulnerable and be short‑term; broad subsidies that meet persistently high oil prices can easily shift from temporary relief to a long‑term fiscal burden.

Europe feels the impact first. France has extended its high‑mileage driver subsidy that was due to end at the end of September; German Chancellor Scholz said he will soon propose measures to help drivers cope with high fuel costs; the UK faces pressure to expand energy support for low‑income households.

The UK regulator Ofgem has confirmed a typical household dual‑fuel bill will rise 4% next month, with an annual cap of about £1,723. Supplier EDF estimates that if wholesale prices stay high, another 26% increase could come in January 2025, with the final rise depending on natural‑gas and electricity wholesale prices before mid‑November.

In addition, Europe’s winter gas inventories are low; storage facilities can normally meet about one‑third of EU winter gas demand, so insufficient stocks make future wholesale gas prices and potential subsidies more sensitive to supply‑demand dynamics.

Some analysts say that at the current replenishment rate, reaching the 75% low‑level target may not be easy. French President Macron said the G7 will discuss releasing strategic oil and fuel reserves in the coming weeks; if that can lower oil prices, it would indirectly ease subsidy pressure.

But bond markets are squeezing policy space. The EU has warned of a “significant rise” in sovereign‑debt yields, urging member states to stick to medium‑term fiscal targets. The EU is also debating an energy windfall tax, but the Commission is cautious about a Europe‑wide levy, leaving the tax design to individual countries.

For governments, expanding energy support means paying two bills at once: subsidising households and firms on one side, and issuing debt at higher rates on the other, so fiscal capacity to lower oil prices is increasingly constrained by bond‑cost pressures.

Asia is re‑balancing between subsidies and cuts. Indonesia has pledged to maintain fuel subsidies, Malaysia is stabilising prices through different mechanisms, and Thailand has been phasing out subsidies since March; differing fiscal space and oil‑price tolerance lead to different paths.

Bangladesh on Monday (the 21st) raised diesel from 115 to 135 taka per litre, with gasoline and kerosene also rising, the highest increase at 17.4%. The Energy Ministry said international oil prices have more than doubled since March and transport costs have risen due to geopolitical tensions; state oil firms lost 228.76 billion taka (about $19 billion) from March to August, and the new price could cut the loss by about 100 billion taka annually and save foreign‑exchange.

Latin America is split. Brazil’s Petrobras added a new diesel subsidy last week of 1 real per litre, which can be stacked with the existing 1.12‑real per litre subsidy. The company disclosed that subsidies for diesel, gasoline and LPG total about 9.9 billion reais, keeping the fiscal burden high.

Bolivia, after the Senate approved a $1.9 billion IMF loan, cancelled its diesel subsidy and moved to a uniform price based on international levels; the government said oil‑gas subsidies cost about $2.6 billion a year, and multilateral loans will no longer be used for “buy high, sell low”. The new plan calls for cutting spending and fully ending fuel subsidies by 2027, while retaining cash transfers, preferential financing, partial import‑tax relief and employment support.

Overall, high oil prices have pushed energy policy into a fiscal dilemma: subsidies can temporarily ease bills but expand deficits and raise borrowing costs; removing subsidies can stabilise finances but pass price pain directly to voters. How winter gas prices, Middle‑East supply and bond yields evolve will determine whether countries move from a “temporary buffer” to a “long‑term burden” or a “reform exit.”

items.title: 中國最大本土MLCC廠風華高科量價齊升AI貢獻仍待放大
items.title_en: China's Largest Domestic MLCC Maker Fenghua High-Tech Raises Prices and Volumes, AI Contribution Still Needs Expansion
paras: 2026年09月22日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 中國被動元件廠風華高科(000636-CN)2026年上半年營收35億元人民幣，年增26.28%；歸母淨利潤2.9億元人民幣，年增74.01%。MLCC、晶片電阻及電感銷量與價格同步成長，營收與主要產品產銷量均創新高。
風華高科第1季歸母淨利潤8,855萬元人民幣，推算第2季約2.01億元人民幣，季增127.8%，反映產品漲價、出貨增加及產能利用率上升。
分市場來看，上半年汽車電子銷售額年增30%、工控年增54%、智慧終端年增14%，超級電容器銷售額年增85%，顯示成長動能不只來自AI，也包括汽車、工控及消費電子需求回升。
風華高科MLCC業務約占營收40%，其中高容量、車規及中高壓等高階產品，占MLCC營收約35%至40%。換算後，高階MLCC約占公司整體營收14%至16%，目前一般型產品仍是主要營收來源。
產能方面，公司MLCC月產能約600億至650億顆。祥和工業園高階電容基地已於2025年底完工，並於2026年4月完成結項，支援今年出貨成長。
技術方面，風華高科MLCC介質厚度已降至0.8微米，並持續開發0.5至0.6微米製程，最高疊層數約1,000層。日本領先廠商已量產0.5至0.6微米產品，疊層數約1,200層，村田製作所(6981-JP)最高達1,600層，風華高科高階技術仍在追趕。
市場先前傳出風華高科通過NVIDIA全系列MLCC認證，公司已公告澄清，NVIDIA從未對公司進行產品認證。現階段成長主要來自MLCC景氣回升、產品量價成長，以及汽車與工控需求增加。
風華高科上半年營業活動現金流量淨額1.61億元人民幣，年減55.64%。公司指出，主要受到金屬原料價格上漲及上游結算政策收緊影響，採購付款速度加快。

paras_en: On September 22, 2026 (Youshi Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Chinese passive component maker Fenghua High-Tech (000636-CN) posted RMB 3.5 billion revenue for the first half of 2026, up 26.28% year‑on‑year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 290 million, up 74.01% year‑on‑year. Sales and prices of MLCCs, chip resistors and inductors grew together, setting new highs for both revenue and the output of its main products.

Fenghua High-Tech’s net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 88.55 million in Q1, and it is estimated to be about RMB 201 million in Q2, a quarterly increase of 127.8%, reflecting product price hikes, higher shipments and improved capacity utilization.

By market segment, automotive electronics sales rose 30% year‑on‑year in the first half, industrial control up 54%, smart terminals up 14%, and super‑capacitor sales up 85%, indicating that growth momentum comes not only from AI but also from a rebound in automotive, industrial‑control and consumer‑electronics demand.

Fenghua High-Tech’s MLCC business accounts for roughly 40% of revenue, with high‑capacity, automotive‑grade and medium‑high‑voltage premium products making up about 35% to 40% of MLCC revenue. After conversion, premium‑grade MLCCs represent about 14% to 16% of the company’s total revenue, while standard‑type products remain the main revenue source.

In terms of capacity, the company’s MLCC monthly output is about 60 billion to 65 billion pieces. The high‑end capacitor base at the Xianghe Industrial Park was completed at the end of 2025 and finalized in April 2026, supporting this year’s shipment growth.

Technologically, Fenghua High-Tech’s MLCC dielectric thickness has been reduced to 0.8 µm, and it continues to develop 0.5‑0.6 µm processes, with a maximum stack count of about 1,000 layers. Leading Japanese manufacturers have already mass‑produced 0.5‑0.6 µm products with around 1,200 layers, and Murata Manufacturing (6981-JP) reaches up to 1,600 layers, so Fenghua’s high‑end technology is still catching up.

There were earlier rumors that Fenghua High-Tech had passed NVIDIA’s full‑range MLCC certification; the company has clarified that NVIDIA has never certified its products. Current growth is mainly driven by the MLCC market recovery, volume‑price gains, and increased automotive and industrial‑control demand.

Fenghua High-Tech’s net cash flow from operating activities in the first half was RMB 161 million, down 55.64% year‑on‑year. The company said this was mainly due to higher metal raw‑material prices and tighter upstream settlement policies, which accelerated payment speeds for purchases.

items.title: SpaceXAI推出Grok 4.7 主打速度倍增、價格降至同級模型一半
items.title_en: SpaceXAI launches Grok 4.7, touting double speed and half the price of comparable models
paras: 2026年09月22日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ SpaceXAI(SPCX-US)推出新一代AI模型Grok 4.7，公司表示，新模型運算速度較同級模型快1倍，價格則約為同級模型的一半，持續加快Grok系列模型更新腳步。
Grok 4.7定價為每100萬個輸入Token收費2美元、輸出Token收費6美元，明顯低於Anthropic Fable 5系列的輸入10美元、輸出50美元；但與中國低價AI模型相比仍較高，DeepSeek-R1每100萬個輸入Token約收費0.15美元（重複內容）或0.60美元（新內容），輸出Token約2.40美元。
SpaceXAI今年持續更新Grok產品。2月推出Grok 4.2，採用4個AI代理並行處理架構；8月再推出Grok 4.6，主要針對長時間運作的AI代理、軟體開發及複雜知識工作進行優化。如今相隔約1個月，Grok 4.7正式推出。
Grok的應用管道也持續增加。除自有平台外，模型已陸續透過雲端平台、開發工具及第三方服務提供，讓企業與開發者可在不同環境使用Grok。

paras_en: September 22, 2026 (You Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – SpaceXAI (SPCX-US) has launched its next‑generation AI model Grok 4.7. The company says the new model runs twice as fast as comparable models and costs about half as much, continuing the rapid update pace of the Grok series.

Grok 4.7 is priced at $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens, clearly lower than Anthropic’s Fable 5 series, which charges $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens. However, it is still more expensive than low‑cost Chinese AI models; DeepSeek‑R1 charges roughly $0.15 per million input tokens for repeated content (or $0.60 for new content) and about $2.40 per million output tokens.

SpaceXAI has been continuously updating its Grok product line this year. In February it released Grok 4.2, which uses a four‑agent parallel processing architecture; in August it rolled out Grok 4.6, optimized for long‑running AI agents, software development, and complex knowledge work. Now, about a month later, Grok 4.7 is officially launched.

The application pipeline for Grok is also expanding. In addition to its own platform, the model is being made available through cloud platforms, development tools, and third‑party services, allowing enterprises and developers to use Grok in various environments.

items.title: 英美深化AI國防合作 柏南赴聯大宣布新夥伴關係
items.title_en: UK and US Deepen AI Defense Cooperation as Burnham Announces New Partnership at the UN General Assembly
paras: 英國首相安迪·柏南(Andy Burnham)將於周二(22日)在紐約舉行的聯合國大會期間宣布英國與美國新的人工智慧(AI)國防合作夥伴關係, 聚焦AI與自主技術, 目標是加快部署可信賴且具互通性的能力, 強化對關鍵基礎設施的保護及對安全威脅的威懾。
這也是柏南就任英國首相後首次參與多邊國際會議。他將在第81屆聯合國大會期間發表演說, 呼籲各國合作運用AI提升安全能力, 同時利用這項技術緩解生活成本壓力。柏南也將與美國總統川普會面。
根據英國政府規劃, 英國國防部的「國防快速AI交付工作小組」(Defence Rapid AI Delivery Taskforce)將與美國戰爭部(Department of War)首席數位與人工智慧辦公室(Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office)合作, 加快「可信賴、可互通能力」的交付, 以提升威懾能力。
柏南在聲明中表示, 英國與美國新的AI及自主技術國防夥伴關係, 將集合相關領域的人才與專業, 加強對關鍵基礎設施的保護, 威懾威脅英國安全的勢力, 並運用AI的潛力。
這項合作涵蓋的關鍵基礎設施範圍廣泛, 從海上航線至領空都包括在內。英國政府希望透過AI及自主技術, 提升對潛在威脅的偵測與應對能力, 同時讓英美雙方的相關技術與系統能夠更有效地協同運作。
英美目前在安全、科技、金融及更廣泛的外交政策領域維持密切合作, 儘管川普兩度執政期間, 雙方也曾出現公開分歧。柏南此次訪美因此具有深化雙邊合作的意義, 而AI國防合作將成為此次行程的重要議題之一。
英國目前是全球第三大AI市場, 僅次於美國與中國。Reuters指出, AI已出現協助英國擺脫長期經濟停滯的早期跡象, 但與此同時, 隨著AI系統能力快速提升, 外界對英國AI安全工作是否跟得上技術發展也日益關注。
英國設有AI安全研究院(AI Security Institute), 該機構是在英國於2023年主辦全球首屆AI安全高峰會後成立, 主要負責測試前沿AI模型, 評估其能力以及可能遭到濫用的風險。不過,根據報導， Anthropic近期未向該研究院提供最新模型, 引發外界對英國目前較偏向合作的AI治理模式是否足以因應日益增加的AI風險的疑慮。
柏南長期主張需要在AI帶來的機會與挑戰之間取得平衡。他預計在此次聯大行程中進一步宣布, 英國將在明年主辦20國集團(G20)期間推動國際社會處理AI等全球性挑戰。
明年的G20峰會預計於11月在英國曼徹斯特舉行。曼徹斯特位於英格蘭西北部, 也是柏南過去擔任地方政府領導人的地區。英國政府希望利用主辦G20的機會, 推動各國就AI所帶來的安全、經濟及社會議題展開更廣泛合作。
此次英美AI國防夥伴關係, 將AI、自主系統及關鍵基礎設施安全連結起來, 反映AI已逐漸成為英美國防與安全合作的重要領域。雙方後續如何落實相關技術合作, 以及如何在提升AI應用的同時處理安全與濫用風險, 將成為合作推進的重要議題。
paras_en: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham will announce a new artificial intelligence (AI) defence partnership with the United States during the United Nations General Assembly in New York on Tuesday (the 22nd), focusing on AI and autonomous technologies, with the goal of accelerating the deployment of trustworthy and interoperable capabilities, strengthening protection of critical infrastructure and deterring security threats.

This is Burnham’s first participation in a multilateral international conference since becoming UK Prime Minister. He will deliver a speech at the 81st UN General Assembly, calling on nations to cooperate in using AI to enhance security capabilities while also leveraging the technology to ease cost‑of‑living pressures. Burnham will also meet US President Trump.

According to the UK government plan, the Ministry of Defence’s Defence Rapid AI Delivery Taskforce will work with the US Department of War’s Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office to speed the delivery of “trustworthy, interoperable capabilities” in order to boost deterrence.

Burnham said the new AI and autonomous‑technology defence partnership between the UK and the US will bring together talent and expertise from the relevant fields, strengthen protection of critical infrastructure, deter forces that threaten UK security, and harness the potential of AI.

The cooperation covers a broad range of critical infrastructure, from maritime routes to airspace. The UK government hopes that AI and autonomous technologies will improve detection and response to potential threats, while enabling UK and US technologies and systems to operate more effectively together.

The UK and US currently maintain close cooperation in security, technology, finance and broader foreign‑policy areas, despite public disagreements during Trump’s two terms in office. Burnham’s visit therefore carries significance for deepening bilateral cooperation, and AI defence collaboration will be a major topic of the trip.

The UK is the world’s third‑largest AI market, behind the United States and China. Reuters notes early signs that AI is helping the UK break out of long‑term economic stagnation, but as AI system capabilities rapidly advance, external observers are increasingly concerned whether the UK’s AI safety work can keep pace with technological development.

The UK has an AI Security Institute, established after the country hosted the world’s first AI security summit in 2023, which is responsible for testing frontier AI models, assessing their capabilities and potential misuse risks. However, reports say Anthropic recently did not provide its latest model to the institute, raising doubts about whether the UK’s relatively collaborative AI‑governance approach is sufficient to address the growing AI risk landscape.

Burnham has long argued for balancing the opportunities and challenges presented by AI. He is expected to further announce during the UNGA that the UK will promote international efforts to tackle AI‑related global challenges during next year’s G20.

Next year’s G20 summit is slated for November in Manchester, England. Manchester, in the northwest of England, is also the region where Burnham previously served as a local government leader. The UK government hopes to use the G20 hosting opportunity to spur broader cooperation among nations on the security, economic and social issues raised by AI.

This UK‑US AI defence partnership links AI, autonomous systems and critical‑infrastructure security, reflecting AI’s growing role in defence and security cooperation between the two countries. How the partners will implement the technical collaboration and address safety and misuse risks while expanding AI applications will be key issues moving forward.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元升至近8周高點 歐元因德國政局受矚
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Rises to Near 8‑Week High; Euro in Focus Over German Politics
paras: 美元周一(19日)小幅走升，來到近8周高點，延續上周強勁漲勢，此前聯準會(Fed)進行了 3年多來首次升息。另一方面，日元在日本銀行(BoJ)決定收緊貨幣政策後，先前一波猛烈跌勢暫歇，歐元則因德國最新民調結果出爐而受矚。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報100.43，創7月29日以來最高。
本月市場最受關注議題之一，就是各大央行的升息行動。歐洲銀行(ECB)、聯準會與日本銀行近期都採取升息措施，且都提到了能源價格推動的通膨壓力。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上周在記者會上表示，「明確的事實就是通膨太高，而且已經持續太久。」
此前，聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率從3.50%-3.75%上調至 3.75%-4.00%。
此外，聯準會更新後的「經濟預測摘要」顯示，至少有12名FOMC委員認為今年還會再升息一次。
在FOMC做出升息決定之前，市場對聯準會升息的預期機率曾飆升至90%。推動市場預期的因素包括：油價急升、美國經濟數據，以及債券市場持續遭到拋售。尤其是固定收益市場投資人對這次升息反應正面，因他們認為這顯示聯準會沒有在通膨問題上落後於形勢。
Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management投資長Brent Schutte表示，「經濟的強勁表現，很可能就是聯準會認為可以升息的原因。但我們也提醒，升息的目的就是要放慢經濟成長速度。因此也會提高政策過度緊縮的風險，因為升息對經濟的影響延遲且不均。」
他進一步表示，「你們或許還記得，聯準會上一輪在2022年和2023年的升息，造成了經濟出現明顯分化。」當時，對利率較敏感的產業、企業及消費者面臨較大壓力，即使整體經濟仍持續成長。
歐元承受德國政治局勢轉變壓力
歐元兌美元下跌0.2%，至1歐元兌1.1463 美元。
歐洲交易市場正在消化周末公布的選舉預測結果。結果顯示，極右翼政黨「德國另類選擇黨」(AfD)在德國東北部的州選舉中取得領先。
這項具歷史意義的結果，直接打擊了德國總理梅爾茨(Friedrich Merz)領導的主流保守派聯盟，也讓歐洲股市面臨新的政治風險。
德銀的Jim Reid表示，「在極右派方面，AfD持續獲得更多支持，主要訴求包括反移民與反建制，尤其是在德國東部地區。」他也指出，左派政黨似乎則成功利用了民眾對住房負擔能力、生活成本以及社會不平等的擔憂。
他補充，「對市場而言，眼前最直接的影響並不是德國國家政策會立刻改變，而是德國政治中心進一步弱化，也再次提醒市場，推動歐洲政治兩極化的力量仍然存在。」
日元在升息、「利率檢查」後走弱
日元周一走弱，延續上周約2%猛烈跌勢。此前日銀公布利率決策後，日元跌至數周低點。
美元兌日元上漲0.3%，來到157.36日元。
日本金融市場周一因三天國定假期而休市。
由於假期期間流動性較低，全球交易員高度警戒日本政府可能進行外匯干預。過去在市場流動性不足的情況下，央行進場買進本國貨幣可能造成更大的價格波動。
讓市場對干預的擔憂進一步升高的是，《日本經濟新聞》上周五報導，日銀曾進行所謂的 「利率檢查」。這是指央行官員打電話給外匯交易部門，詢問市場上實際的買賣價。
日本銀行上周五將借貸成本提高至1.25%，創下31年來最高水準。
然而，兩名委員投下偏寬鬆政策的反對票，加上日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)強調政策需要進行預先性的調整，最初反而引發市場「利多出盡」反應。
這也迫使日本當局開始採取更積極的口頭警告及「利率檢查」，以支撐日元匯率。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Monday (the 19th), reaching a near‑8‑week high and continuing last week’s strong rally after the Federal Reserve delivered its first rate hike in more than three years. Meanwhile, the yen’s sharp slide eased after the Bank of Japan tightened policy, and the euro drew attention following the release of Germany’s latest poll results.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 100.43, its highest level since July 29.

One of the market’s top topics this month is the rate‑hike actions of major central banks. The European Central Bank, the Federal Reserve and the Bank of Japan have all recently raised rates and all cited inflation pressure from energy prices.
Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said at a press conference last week that “the clear fact is that inflation is too high and has been too persistent.”
Earlier, the Federal Open Market Committee voted unanimously to lift the federal funds rate range from 3.50‑3.75% to 3.75‑4.00%.
In addition, the Fed’s updated Summary of Economic Projections showed that at least 12 FOMC members expect another rate hike this year.

Before the FOMC’s decision, market expectations for a Fed hike had surged to 90%. Drivers of that expectation included a sharp rise in oil prices, U.S. economic data and continued bond‑market selling. Fixed‑income investors reacted positively, seeing the hike as evidence that the Fed is not lagging behind inflation pressures.

Brent Schutte, Chief Investment Officer at Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management, said, “The economy’s strong performance is likely why the Fed feels it can raise rates. But we remind that the purpose of tightening is to slow growth, which raises the risk of overtightening because the impact of rate hikes is delayed and uneven.”

He added, “You may recall the Fed’s previous tightening cycles in 2022‑2023 caused a clear split in the economy.” At that time, rate‑sensitive industries, firms and consumers felt heightened pressure even as overall growth continued.
Euro Under Pressure From Shifts in German Politics
The euro fell 0.2% against the dollar to $1.1463 per euro.
European markets are digesting the election‑forecast results released over the weekend, which showed the far‑right Alternative for Germany (AfD) leading in state elections in Germany’s northeast.
The historic outcome directly hit the mainstream conservative Union bloc led by Chancellor Friedrich Merz and added new political risk to European equities.

Jim Reid of Deutsche Bank said, “On the far‑right, the AfD is gaining more support, driven mainly by anti‑immigration and anti‑establishment messages, especially in eastern Germany.” He also noted that left‑wing parties seem to be capitalising on public concerns about housing affordability, living costs and social inequality.

He added, “For markets, the most immediate impact isn’t an immediate change in German national policy, but a further weakening of Germany’s political centre, reminding investors that forces driving European political polarisation remain present.”
Yen Weakens After Rate Hike and “Rate Check”
The yen weakened on Monday, extending last week’s roughly 2% plunge. Earlier, the yen fell to a multi‑week low after the BOJ announced its rate decision.
The dollar rose 0.3% against the yen to 157.36 yen.
Japan’s financial markets were closed on Monday for a three‑day national holiday.

Because liquidity is thin during the holiday, global traders are on high alert for possible foreign‑exchange intervention by the Japanese government. In past low‑liquidity episodes, central‑bank purchases of the domestic currency have amplified price swings.

Market worries about intervention were heightened after Nikkei reported last Friday that the BOJ had carried out a so‑called “rate check,” meaning officials called FX desks to ask about actual bid‑ask prices in the market.
The Bank of Japan raised its borrowing cost to 1.25% last Friday, the highest level in 31 years.

However, two board members cast votes for a more accommodative stance, and Governor Kazuo Ueda stressed that policy needed a pre‑emptive adjustment, initially prompting a “no‑more‑good‑news” reaction in the market.
That forced Japanese authorities to adopt more aggressive verbal warnings and conduct “rate checks” to support the yen’s exchange rate.

items.title: 日本救日元反成賣點！瑞銀資管等再度干預伺機賣出
items.title_en: Japan's Yen Rescue Becomes a Selling Point! UBS Asset Management and Others May Intervene Again to Sell
paras: 瑞銀資產管理(UBS Asset Management)全球主權與貨幣固定收益主管Kevin Zhao表示，若日本政府再度出手干預匯市、拉抬日元，將是賣出日元的好機會。他並不認為日銀上周五升息，意味貨幣政策已明顯轉向鷹派。
Zhao今年稍早原本加碼持有日元，但在美日兩國7月大規模聯手買進日元後賣出部位，如今正等待下一次進場賣出的時機。當時日元兌美元一度貶至約164日元，創40年來最低水準。
日銀上周升息，並宣告貨幣政策已進入「新階段」，但Zhao認為，無論是進一步升息或政府再次干預，都不足以讓投資人相信日元能夠持續走強。他直言，日本維持弱勢日元的根本政策並未改變，美元兌日元接下來可能繼續攀升，日本當局最終仍會再度干預，否則恐怕顏面盡失。
日元本月初一度因市場預期日銀將加快升息而反彈，但上周五升息後支撐有限，匯價再度朝164日元關卡靠近。日本當局隨後向市場參與者進行匯率「詢價」，這項行動通常被視為正式進場買進日元的前兆。
目前交易員押注日銀至明年6月最多還會升息3次，但也預期聯準會(Fed)同期將升息相同次數，意味美日利差未必明顯縮小。Zhao反問，若Fed降息期間美元兌日元都未能大幅回落，如今Fed轉向升息，日元又怎麼可能顯著升值？
Zhao預期，即使日本通膨隨經濟成長升溫，日銀未來幾個月仍會放慢緊縮腳步。日本首相高市早苗延續前首相安倍晉三的「安倍經濟學」路線，堅持透過財政支出支撐經濟。在股市大漲、名目國內生產毛額(GDP)成長及政府債務龐大的情況下，低利率仍符合政府與日銀利益。他強調，「安倍經濟學從來不等於強勢日元」。
paras_en: UBS Asset Management’s global sovereign and currency fixed‑income head Kevin Zhao said that if the Japanese government intervenes again in the FX market to prop up the yen, it would be a good opportunity to sell the yen. He does not believe that the Bank of Japan’s rate hike last Friday signals a clear hawkish shift in monetary policy.

Zhao had increased his yen holdings earlier this year, but sold those positions after the United States and Japan jointly bought large amounts of yen in July. He is now waiting for the next chance to re‑enter and sell. At that time the yen fell to about ¥164 per dollar, its lowest level in 40 years.

The BOJ raised rates last week and announced that monetary policy had entered a “new stage,” but Zhao thinks that whether the BOJ hikes further or the government intervenes again, neither will convince investors that the yen can stay strong. He bluntly says Japan’s fundamental policy of keeping a weak yen has not changed, the dollar‑yen pair may keep climbing, and the authorities will eventually intervene again or risk losing face.

The yen briefly rebounded earlier this month on expectations that the BOJ would accelerate rate hikes, but the support faded after the Friday hike and the exchange rate moved back toward the ¥164 level. Japanese authorities then sent a “price inquiry” to market participants, an action usually seen as a prelude to officially buying yen.

Traders currently bet that the BOJ may raise rates up to three more times by June next year, while also expecting the Fed to raise rates the same number of times, meaning the US‑Japan rate differential may not narrow much. Zhao retorts that if the dollar‑yen pair did not fall significantly during the Fed’s rate‑cut cycle, how could the yen appreciate markedly now that the Fed is back to tightening?

Zhao expects that even if Japanese inflation rises with economic growth, the BOJ will slow its tightening over the next few months. Prime Minister Kishida continues former Prime Minister Abe’s “Abenomics” approach, insisting on fiscal spending to support the economy. With a booming stock market, nominal GDP growth and massive government debt, low rates still suit both the government and the BOJ. He stresses that “Abenomics has never meant a strong yen.”

items.title: 南韓央行啟動24小時韓元交割網路試點
items.title_en: South Korea's Central Bank Launches 24-Hour Won Settlement Network Pilot
paras: 南韓中央銀行(BOK)周一(21日)正式啟動首個24小時韓元交割網路的試營運。此系統於當地時間周一上午9點開始運行，首波由國民銀行(KB Kookmin)、友利銀行(Woori)、韓亞銀行(Hana)與新韓銀行(Shinhan)等四家南韓本土商業銀行率先參與。
在開運首晨約9點30分，兩家參試本土機構成功完成首筆測試交易，金額約為14億韓元(約合100萬美元)。
這項全天候交割機制在工作日實行24小時不間斷運作，僅在周末與國定假日休市。其最大特色在於允許境外外國投資人透過「韓元業務註冊外國機構」(RFI-K)開設的帳戶，在其所在地的當地營業時間直接辦理韓元交易結算與交割，無須親自在南韓境內金融機構開立帳戶。
此舉顯著改善了過去歐美投資人因時差問題而面臨的債券與資產交割延宕困境。
此次試營運為南韓政府推動「韓元國際化路線圖」及外匯改革計畫的重要推手。先前南韓在岸韓元對美元外匯市場已於7月邁入全天候交易，本次交割網路補足了配套支付基礎設施，旨在提升韓元的國際地位，並積極爭取納入 MSCI 發達市場指數。
這一網路預計經約3個月測試後，於2027年1月正式上線營運，屆時將擴大邀請全球主要外資銀行及金融機構全面接入。
paras_en: South Korea's central bank (BOK) officially launched the pilot operation of its first 24‑hour won settlement network on Monday (the 21st). The system began running at 9:00 a.m. local time, with four domestic commercial banks – KB Kookmin, Woori, Hana and Shinhan – participating in the initial wave.

Around 9:30 a.m. on the first morning of operation, two of the participating domestic institutions successfully completed the first test transaction, amounting to roughly 1.4 billion won (about US$1 million).

The round‑the‑clock settlement mechanism operates continuously 24 hours on business days, closing only on weekends and public holidays. Its key feature is that foreign investors can settle and deliver won transactions directly during their own local business hours through accounts opened via the "Registered Foreign Institution for Won Business" (RFI‑K), without needing to open an account at a Korean financial institution.
This move markedly eases the bond and asset settlement delays that European and U.S. investors previously faced due to time‑zone differences.

The pilot supports South Korea's government push for a "Won Internationalisation Roadmap" and foreign‑exchange reform, following the launch of all‑day on‑shore won‑USD trading in July. The new settlement network adds the necessary payment infrastructure to boost the won's global standing and to help secure inclusion in the MSCI Developed Markets index.

The network is expected to undergo about three months of testing before going live in January 2027, at which point it will invite major global foreign banks and financial institutions to connect fully.

items.title: 升息失望與干預疑慮交織 日元在連假流動性低迷下恐加劇波動
items.title_en: Rate Hike Disappointment and Intervention Concerns Intertwine, Yen May See Heightened Volatility Amid Low Liquidity During Holiday
paras: 日元對美元在上周重挫逾2%後，於周一(21日)盤初暫告企穩，報156.85日元兌1美元。然而，隨著日本「白銀周」到來，交易員擔心，在市場流動性大幅下降後，恐加劇匯率波動。
日本央行上周五雖然將政策利率調升至1.25%，創下31年來新高，然而會中出現2票反對，加上總裁植田和男並未提供明確的未來升息指引，使寄望鷹派立場的投資人感到失望，引發日元走跌，盤中一度下挫1.3%。
隨後市場傳出日本官方進行「匯率檢查」(rate check)，雖稍微收斂跌幅並收於156.88日元，但依然凸顯出匯市強烈的干預疑慮與風險。
目前，日本正逢「白銀周」連續休假，市場交易流動性大幅下降，投資人對官方干預保持高度戒備。分析指出，流動性較低時易引發劇烈波動，但也為當局介入提供放大效果的契機，一如今年4月至5月黃金周期間日元跌破160關卡後的干預舉措。
財務省數據顯示，日本當局於7月下旬至8月26日期間，曾砸下創紀錄的15.4兆日元進行美日協調干預，帶動日元從7月接近164的40年低點，一度強勢反彈至9月初的152.89高峰。
然而，美日央行政策分歧再次為日元帶來下行壓力。聯準會近期發出鷹派訊號，市場預計10月繼續升息的機率升至55%；反觀日央行10月升息的機率，已被掉期市場定價降至20%以下。
監管數據顯示，投機客在日央行會前將日元淨多頭部位推升至97億美元(創2025年7月以來新高)。但在日央行政策指引缺乏明確鷹派訊號的情況下，這批多頭押注正面臨極大回檔風險。
paras_en: The yen slipped more than 2% against the dollar last week, but on Monday (the 21st) it briefly steadied in early trade at 156.85 yen per $1.

Although the Bank of Japan raised its policy rate to 1.25% last Friday – a 31‑year high – two votes were cast against the move and Governor Kazuo Ueda gave no clear guidance on future hikes, leaving investors who had hoped for a hawkish stance disappointed and sending the yen down, at one point falling 1.3% intraday.

Subsequently, reports emerged that Japanese authorities were conducting a “rate check,” which trimmed the decline slightly and closed at 156.88 yen, but the episode still underscored strong market fears of possible intervention.

Japan is currently in the middle of “Silver Week,” a string of holidays that has sharply reduced market liquidity, prompting investors to stay on high alert for official action. Analysts note that low‑liquidity environments can trigger sharp moves, yet they also give authorities a bigger impact if they choose to step in, as seen after the yen fell below the 160‑yen barrier during the gold‑price rally in April‑May this year.

Ministry of Finance data show that Japanese authorities intervened with a record‑breaking 15.4 trillion yen in coordinated US‑Japan action from late July to August 26, lifting the yen from near a 40‑year low of about 164 in July to a strong rebound of 152.89 in early September.

However, policy divergence between the Fed and the BOJ is again weighing on the yen. The Fed’s recent hawkish signals have pushed the market’s odds of another October hike to 55%, while the BOJ’s chance of an October hike has been priced by the swap market at below 20%.

Regulatory data indicate that speculators pushed net long positions on the yen to $9.7 billion ahead of the BOJ meeting – a high not seen since July 2025 – but with the BOJ offering no clear hawkish guidance, those long bets now face a substantial risk of a sharp unwind.

items.title: 川習會前夕中國人行放寬升值干預 人民幣匯率創逾3年半新高
items.title_en: China's Central Bank Eases RMB Appreciation Controls Ahead of Trump‑Xi Summit, RMB Hits Over 3‑Year‑Half High
paras: 在美國總統川普與中國國家主席習近平本周將舉行峰會之際，中國人民銀行放寬了對人民幣升值的限制，帶動人民幣對美元匯率於周一(21日)升至逾3年半以來的新高。
周一早盤，境內人民幣對美元一度觸及 6.6957，創下 2023 年 1 月 16 日以來的最高點；離岸人民幣升至 6.6946。
開盤前，中國人行將人民幣對美元中間價設在 6.7487，雖創下 2023 年 2 月 3 日以來的新高，但仍比《路透》調查的市場預測值弱了 536 個基點。
本次匯率走強適逢美中兩國高層密集會談。美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)與中國國務院副總理何立峰於周日在紐約結束會談，為川普與習近平預計於周四舉行的峰會鋪路。外界預期雙方將討論人工智慧、貿易關係、供應鏈及中東緊張局勢等議題，但分析師預估不會有重大政策突破。
針對人行近期縮小中間價與市場預期差距的舉措，高盛分析師在報告中表示，人行在川習會召開前調強中間價的作法符合近年歷史經驗，這為離岸人民幣現貨價格進一步走強創造了更大空間。
華僑銀行(OCBC)則在報告中指出，較強且相對穩定的人民幣有助於為美中談判創造更有建設性的背景，並減少美方再度指責競爭性貶值的可能性。
然而，華僑銀行也表示，不應將此視為人民幣長期升值周期的開始，並指出：「鑑於美中兩國之間龐大的利差以及中國國內依然疲軟的基本面，近期部分升值可能僅反映了峰會期間由政策維護的穩定性，而非人民幣基本面的重新估值。」
paras_en: As U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping prepare to hold a summit this week, the People’s Bank of China has loosened restrictions on RMB appreciation, pushing the RMB‑USD exchange rate up to a new high not seen in over three and a half years on Monday (the 21st).
In early trade on Monday, the onshore RMB briefly touched 6.6957 per dollar, the highest level since Jan. 16, 2023, while offshore RMB rose to 6.6946.
Before the market opened, the PBOC set the RMB‑USD midpoint at 6.7487, a fresh peak since Feb. 3, 2023, yet still 53.6 basis points weaker than the market forecast gathered by Reuters.

The currency rally comes amid intensive high‑level talks between the United States and China. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese Vice‑Premier He Lifeng concluded talks in New York on Sunday, paving the way for the Trump‑Xi summit slated for Thursday. Observers expect discussions on AI, trade, supply chains and Middle‑East tensions, though analysts doubt any major policy breakthroughs will emerge.

Commenting on the PBOC’s recent narrowing of the gap between the midpoint and market expectations, a Goldman Sachs analyst said that strengthening the midpoint ahead of the summit follows historical patterns and creates more room for offshore RMB spot prices to rise further.

OCBC Bank noted in its report that a stronger and relatively stable RMB helps create a more constructive backdrop for U.S.–China negotiations and reduces the likelihood of the U.S. accusing China of competitive devaluation again.

However, OCBC cautioned that this should not be seen as the start of a long‑term RMB appreciation cycle, stating: “Given the large interest‑rate differential between the United States and China and still‑weak domestic fundamentals in China, the recent modest appreciation may simply reflect policy‑backed stability during the summit period rather than a fundamental re‑valuation of the RMB.”

items.title: 風向要變了？對沖基金近一年多來首次看漲日元
items.title_en: Is the Wind Changing? Hedge Funds Turn Bullish on the Yen for the First Time in Over a Year
paras: 日本央行升息之際，對沖基金對日元的立場出現重大轉向，自2025年7月以來首次轉為淨多頭，顯示在美日兩國當局入市干預後，外匯市場情緒已明顯改變。
不過，日本央行最新政策訊號不如部分投資人預期鷹派，使剛轉向看漲日元的交易商立即面臨壓力。
根據美國商品期貨交易委員會（CFTC）上周五(18日)公布的數據，截至9月15日當周，槓桿交易商已全數回補先前建立的日元空頭部位，並開始轉向做多日元。
彭博彙整數據顯示，相關基金目前持有約2,510億日元（約16億美元）的日元多頭部位。這是自2025年7月以來，對沖基金首度對日元持淨看漲立場，反映投機資金對日元後市的看法出現明顯逆轉。
這波倉位調整發生在美日當局入市干預數周後。根據彭博先前報導，美國財政部長貝森特曾表示，美方參與日元干預屬於「象徵性」行動，並表態支持美國出口競爭力。官方行動及政策訊號，成為市場重新評估日元走勢的重要因素。
日銀訊號不夠鷹派
對沖基金完成多空立場轉換的時機相當微妙。聯準會與日本央行本周相繼調高利率，但日本央行對未來政策的表態，未能滿足部分市場參與者對持續升息的預期，導致日元在升息後反而走弱，也讓剛建立多頭部位的交易商陷入被動。
日元周五盤中一度下跌1.3%，隨後跌幅收窄，紐約尾盤報約156.80日元兌1美元。根據《日經新聞》報導，日本央行已向市場參與者詢問匯率水準。此類「匯率詢價」通常被市場視為官方可能出手干預的前兆，消息傳出後，日元跌勢隨即有所緩和。
美元多頭同步降溫
與此同時，包括資產管理機構及非商業交易商在內的投機性交易人，截至9月15日已將美元淨多頭部位降至3月以來最低水準，顯示市場先前不僅提高對日元的看漲押注，也同步降低對美元的多頭布局。
然而，美元本周隨後強勢反彈，單周漲幅創下近三個月最大，使先前減持美元的交易商同樣承受壓力。日元多頭增加、美元多頭降溫，與本周實際匯率走勢形成落差，凸顯央行政策訊號仍主導短線外匯市場。
CFTC持倉數據提供市場觀察外匯交易情緒的重要窗口，反映對沖基金與資產管理機構透過衍生性金融商品建立的整體部位方向。
目前全球外匯市場日均成交規模達9.5兆美元，日元能否延續看漲氣氛，仍取決於日本央行後續升息訊號及官方是否進一步干預匯市。
paras_en: As the Bank of Japan raises rates, hedge funds have made a major shift in their yen stance, moving to a net long position for the first time since July 2025, indicating that forex market sentiment has clearly changed after interventions by U.S. and Japanese authorities.
However, the latest policy signals from the BOJ are less hawkish than some investors expected, putting immediate pressure on traders who have just turned bullish on the yen.

According to data released by the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) on Friday the 18th, by the week ending September 15 leveraged traders had fully covered their previously established short yen positions and begun to go long the currency.

Bloomberg’s compiled data show that the relevant funds now hold about ¥251 billion (roughly $1.6 billion) of long yen positions. This is the first net‑bullish stance on the yen by hedge funds since July 2025, reflecting a clear reversal in speculative sentiment toward the currency’s outlook.

The position adjustment comes weeks after U.S. and Japanese authorities stepped into the market. Bloomberg previously reported that U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen described the U.S. side of the yen intervention as a “symbolic” action and voiced support for U.S. export competitiveness. Official actions and policy signals have become key factors in the market’s reassessment of yen direction.
BOJ signals not hawkish enough

The timing of hedge funds’ long‑short switch is delicate. The Fed and the BOJ both raised rates this week, but the BOJ’s forward guidance failed to meet some market participants’ expectations for continued tightening, causing the yen to weaken after the rate hike and leaving newly‑long traders on the back foot.

The yen fell as much as 1.3% intraday on Friday before narrowing its loss, closing the New York session around ¥156.80 per $1. According to the Nikkei, the BOJ has queried market participants on exchange‑rate levels – a “rate inquiry” that markets usually interpret as a possible precursor to official intervention, which tempered the yen’s decline when the news broke.
Dollar bulls cool off

At the same time, speculative traders, including asset managers and non‑commercial participants, had reduced their net long dollar positions to the lowest level since March as of September 15, showing that the market not only increased its bullish bets on the yen but also scaled back its long dollar exposure.

Nevertheless, the dollar rebounded strongly later in the week, posting its biggest weekly gain in nearly three months, putting pressure on traders who had trimmed dollar exposure. The rise in yen longs and the cooling of dollar longs contrast with the week’s actual exchange‑rate moves, underscoring that central‑bank signals still dominate short‑term forex dynamics.
CFTC position data provide an important window into forex‑trading sentiment, reflecting the overall directional bias of hedge funds and asset managers through derivative instruments.

The global forex market now sees a daily turnover of about $9.5 trillion. Whether the yen can sustain its bullish momentum will still depend on the BOJ’s future rate‑hike signals and whether officials step up intervention in the currency market.
